items.title_en: AI for Biologists: The Knowledge Boundaries of Foundation Models in the Age of Agentic Systems
items.title_zh: 面向生物学家的 AI：智能体时代基础模型的知识边界
items.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how biological research is done. Biological foundation models trained on millions of nucleotides, protein, and single-cell measurements predict protein structures, mutation effects, and cellular responses to genetic perturbations. Agentic systems, AI assistants built on large language models, can run multistep analyses from plain-language requests and increasingly call foundation models as tools. Yet it is often unclear when these models' outputs can be trusted. We frame this as a model's knowledge boundary: the range of inputs, tasks, and conditions over which its outputs are reliable. This review explains how foundation models are built and proposes that five design elements (data, architecture, training scheme, evaluation scheme, and post-analysis) define this boundary. We examine evidence on where current models succeed or fail and present standardized descriptions of model limits so that researchers, and the agents acting for them, can use these tools reliably.
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能正在改变生物学研究的方式。基于数百万条核苷酸、蛋白质和单细胞测量数据训练的生物学基础模型，能够预测蛋白质结构、突变效应以及细胞对遗传扰动的响应。智能体系统——构建于大语言模型之上的 AI 助手——可以依据自然语言请求执行多步骤分析，并越来越多地把基础模型作为工具调用。然而，这些模型的输出何时可信往往并不清楚。我们将其界定为模型的“知识边界”：即其输出可靠所覆盖的输入、任务与条件的范围。本综述阐释基础模型的构建方式，并提出五个设计要素（数据、架构、训练方案、评估方案与事后分析）共同定义了该边界。我们考察当前模型在何处成功、何处失败的证据，并提出模型局限性的标准化描述方式，使研究人员及其代理智能体能够可靠地使用这些工具。
items.highlight_zh: 用五个设计要素界定基础模型的知识边界，助其可靠使用
items.digest_zh:
【研究问题】生物学家越来越多地用 AI 做事：在数百万条核苷酸、蛋白质、单细胞数据上训练的基础模型可以预测蛋白结构、突变效应、细胞对基因扰动的反应；而构建在大语言模型上的“智能体”还能按自然语言指令跑多步分析，并调用这些基础模型当工具。但关键疑问是：它们的输出什么时候可以信？

【方法】作者把这一问题概念化为“知识边界”，即模型输出可靠所覆盖的输入、任务与条件范围。综述首先解释基础模型是如何构建的，进而提出五个设计要素——数据、架构、训练方案、评估方案与事后分析——共同决定了边界落在哪里。

【结果/论点】文章梳理了现有模型成功与失败的证据，指出边界并非模糊直觉，而可以从上述设计要素推导与刻画；并提出对模型局限性的标准化描述方式。

【为何重要】当研究人员乃至替他们行动的 AI 智能体都在调用这些模型时，清楚知道“能信到哪一步”至关重要。标准化的边界描述有助于避免误用与过度外推，让 AI 真正成为可靠的科研工具，而不仅是漂亮的结果生成器。

items.title_en: Tunable coupling between valley and magnetic excitons in WS2/CrSBr heterostructures
items.title_zh: WS2/CrSBr 异质结构中谷激子与磁激子之间的可调耦合
items.abstract_en: Interfacial coupling in van der Waals two-dimensional (2D) heterostructures offers an effective route to tailor the electronic, optical, and magnetic properties of materials. Versatile control and precise engineering of such interlayer interactions can be further achieved through external parameters, like electric field, magnetic field, optical excitation, as well as layer stacking geometries. Here, we examined the magneto-optical properties of 2D semiconductor heterostructures made of antiferromagnetic CrSBr and a monolayer WS2, both of which host intriguing excitonic properties. We identified a type-II band alignment between these two layers and the magnetic proximity effects from CrSBr, manifested by an enhanced Zeeman valley splitting in the WS2 layer. The interlayer charge transfer shows strong spin selectivity and is governed by the relative alignment between the valley-spin polarization of photoexcited carriers in WS2 and the magnetization in CrSBr, giving rise to spin-sensitive circularly polarized photoluminescence (PL) from WS2. Furthermore, the highly anisotropic electronic dispersion in CrSBr enables stacking-dependent control of interlayer interactions, as inferred from a twist-angle dependence of PL quenching. Our work establishes a highly tunable 2D system that integrates valleytronics and magnetic excitons through multiple coupling channels, opening up new opportunities in all-optical manipulation of spin and magnon states and for the development of flexible spin-optoelectronic devices.
items.abstract_zh: 范德华二维（2D）异质结构中的界面耦合为调控材料的电子、光学和磁性质提供了一条有效途径。通过电场、磁场、光激发以及层堆叠几何结构等外部参数，可以进一步实现对这类层间相互作用的灵活控制和精确工程化。在此，我们研究了由反铁磁 CrSBr 和单层 WS2 构成的二维半导体异质结构的磁光性质，二者均具有引人关注的激子特性。我们确认了这两层之间的 II 型能带排列以及来自 CrSBr 的磁邻近效应，其表现为 WS2 层中增强的塞曼谷劈裂。层间电荷转移表现出强烈的自旋选择性，并受 WS2 中光激发载流子的谷-自旋极化与 CrSBr 中磁化强度之间相对取向的支配，从而产生来自 WS2 的自旋敏感圆偏振光致发光（PL）。此外，CrSBr 中高度各向异性的电子色散使得层间相互作用可实现依赖于堆叠方式的调控，这一点由 PL 猝灭的扭转角依赖性推断得出。我们的工作建立了一个高度可调的二维体系，通过多个耦合通道将谷电子学与磁激子集成在一起，为自旋和磁振子态的全光操控以及柔性自旋光电子器件的开发开辟了新机遇。

items.title_en: SpaceMCP: Vision Language Model Spatial Reasoning via Model Context Protocol
items.title_zh: SpaceMCP：通过模型上下文协议实现视觉语言模型空间推理
items.abstract_en: Despite impressive advances in large language models (LLM), vision-language models (VLM) still exhibit limited spatial reasoning capabilities. Recent progress in feed-forward 3D reconstruction has enabled precise, real-time geometric understanding from visual inputs. In this work, we propose SpaceMCP, a framework that leverages these advances to introduce an MCP-style paradigm for spatial reasoning. Our approach augments a VLM with structured function calls, allowing it to query a scene graph for spatial information such as distances, object positioning, and camera properties. The scene graph is constructed in real time using feed-forward 3D reconstruction to recover metric geometry, combined with open-vocabulary segmentation to identify and localize relevant objects within the scene. Paired with the VLM's strong reasoning capabilities, the VLM is able to combine this primitive information to solve more complex spatial tasks. Without any training, SpaceMCP achieves state-of-the-art results on VSI-Bench, MMSI-Bench and VSTI-Bench, outperforming recent spatially post-trained VLMs and improving its base VLM by 15-22 points per benchmark. We argue that, given the contrast between the relatively slow progress in native VLM spatial reasoning and the rapid advances in feed-forward 3D computer vision, this paradigm offers a promising path forward for enabling robust spatial reasoning.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）取得了令人瞩目的进展，视觉语言模型（VLM）仍表现出有限的空间推理能力。前馈三维重建的最新进展使得从视觉输入中进行精确、实时的几何理解成为可能。在这项工作中，我们提出 SpaceMCP，一个利用这些进展引入 MCP 风格空间推理范式的框架。我们的方法通过结构化函数调用增强 VLM，使其能够查询场景图以获取空间信息，如距离、物体定位和相机属性。场景图使用前馈三维重建实时构建以恢复度量几何，并结合开放词汇分割来识别和定位场景中的相关物体。结合 VLM 强大的推理能力，VLM 能够组合这些原始信息来解决更复杂的空间任务。在没有任何训练的情况下，SpaceMCP 在 VSI-Bench、MMSI-Bench 和 VSTI-Bench 上取得最先进结果，优于近期经过空间后训练的 VLM，并在每个基准上将其基础 VLM 提高 15–22 个点。我们认为，鉴于原生 VLM 空间推理进展相对缓慢与前馈三维计算机视觉快速进展之间的对比，这一范式为实现稳健空间推理提供了一条有前景的路径。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对传感器、标定、尺度与算力；重建画质和可用的定位精度属于不同指标。

items.title_en: VEPO: Mitigating Multilingual Hallucinations in LVLMs via Visual Evidence-guided Preference Optimization
items.title_zh: VEPO：通过视觉证据引导的偏好优化缓解 LVLM 中的多语言幻觉
items.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) achieve strong multimodal performance, yet they remain prone to object hallucination---generating answers that are linguistically fluent but visually ungrounded. This issue is especially severe in low-resource languages, where weaker cross-modal alignment causes models to rely more on language priors than on image evidence. Existing remedies either require costly multilingual annotations or external translation/reward models, or intervene at inference time in ways that can distort the output language. We propose VEPO(Visual Evidence-guided Preference Optimization), a training-time method that transfers reliable visual grounding from English to other languages without external models. VEPO first localizes key visual evidence using English queries via mid-layer cross-modal attention, then constructs preference pairs that share the same correct answer but differ in evidence sufficiency (full image vs.\ key-region masked image). Direct preference optimization on these pairs encourages low-resource inputs to prefer answers supported by complete visual evidence. Experiments on multilingual POPE and MME with Chinese, French, and Hindi show consistent hallucination reduction and perception gains, with the largest improvements on the lowest-resource language. Analyses further confirm that VEPO sharpens question-relevant attention and that evidence-guided masking outperforms random masking.
items.abstract_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）取得了强劲的多模态性能，但仍易出现物体幻觉——生成语言流畅但视觉上缺乏依据的答案。该问题在低资源语言中尤为严重，因为较弱的跨模态对齐使模型更多依赖语言先验而非图像证据。现有补救方法要么需要昂贵的多语言标注或外部翻译/奖励模型，要么在推理时进行干预，而这种方式可能扭曲输出语言。我们提出 VEPO（视觉证据引导的偏好优化，Visual Evidence-guided Preference Optimization），这是一种训练时方法，可在不使用外部模型的情况下将可靠的视觉依据（visual grounding）从英语迁移到其他语言。VEPO 首先通过中间层跨模态注意力使用英语查询定位关键视觉证据，然后构建偏好对，这些偏好对共享相同的正确答案，但在证据充分性上不同（完整图像 vs.\ 关键区域被掩码的图像）。对这些偏好对进行直接偏好优化，促使低资源输入偏好由完整视觉证据支持的答案。在中文、法语和印地语的多语言 POPE 和 MME 上的实验显示幻觉持续减少、感知能力提升，其中在资源最少的语言上改进最大。分析进一步证实，VEPO 使与问题相关的注意力更加锐化，且证据引导的掩码优于随机掩码。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Vision-Language-Action Models: A Life-Cycle Survey of Design, Training and Deployment
items.title_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型：设计、训练与部署的生命周期综述
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt web-pretrained vision-language models to output robot actions, so that web knowledge carries over to physical control. In under 4 years the field has moved from RT-2, the first VLA, to open models that fine-tune on a single consumer GPU and to proprietary generalists that clean unseen homes. This survey reviews 88 works from December 2022 to October 2026, mainly on manipulation and navigation, plus humanoid control, world-action models and evaluation. We follow a VLA through its life cycle, from model design to training and deployment, along seven axes. Model design covers (a) inputs and memory, what the model observes; (b) architecture, how its pipeline is built; (c) action output, how it produces motor commands; and (d) intermediate predictions, what else it predicts, from reasoning steps to future observations. Training covers (e) pretraining data, the mix of robot, web, human and simulated data, and (f) post-training, adaptation to the target robot. Deployment covers (g) real-time execution, keeping pace with the robot. We analyse 22 models on these axes and report their training data, model size, inference speed and hardware. Three trends emerge: (i) training data has broadened, from about 10,000 hours of teleoperated robot data ($π_0$) to 23,000 community-collected episodes (SmolVLA) and 20,000 hours of egocentric human video (GR00T N1.7); (ii) model sizes have split: most recent models have 3-7 billion parameters, while a new group under one billion runs on consumer GPUs; and (iii) generalist VLAs are emerging that handle both manipulation and navigation, such as UniVLA and Qwen-VLA. We also compare VLAs with world-action models, which predict future observations as well as actions. We review evidence that some VLAs with near-perfect benchmark scores fail when objects or the camera move slightly, and open up further research questions.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将网络预训练的视觉-语言模型适配为输出机器人动作，从而使网络知识迁移到物理控制中。在不到 4 年的时间里，该领域已从首个 VLA 模型 RT-2 发展到可在单块消费级 GPU 上微调的开源模型，以及能够打扫未见过的住宅的专有通用模型。本综述回顾了 2022 年 12 月至 2026 年 10 月的 88 项工作，主要涉及操作与导航，并涵盖人形控制、世界-动作模型和评估。我们沿七个维度追踪 VLA 的生命周期，从模型设计到训练与部署。模型设计涵盖 (a) 输入与记忆，即模型观察到什么；(b) 架构，即其流水线如何构建；(c) 动作输出，即它如何产生运动命令；以及 (d) 中间预测，即它还预测什么，从推理步骤到未来观测。训练涵盖 (e) 预训练数据，即机器人、网络、人类和仿真数据的混合，以及 (f) 后训练，即对目标机器人的适配。部署涵盖 (g) 实时执行，即与机器人保持同步。我们沿这些维度分析了 22 个模型，并报告了它们的训练数据、模型规模、推理速度和硬件。呈现出三个趋势：(i) 训练数据不断拓宽，从约 10,000 小时的遥操作机器人数据（$π_0$）到 23,000 个社区收集的回合（SmolVLA）以及 20,000 小时的第一人称人类视频（GR00T N1.7）；(ii) 模型规模出现分化：大多数近期模型具有 30 亿至 70 亿参数，而一个低于 10 亿参数的新群体可在消费级 GPU 上运行；以及 (iii) 正在出现同时处理操作与导航的通用 VLA，例如 UniVLA 和 Qwen-VLA。我们还将 VLA 与同时预测未来观测和动作的世界-动作模型进行了比较。我们回顾了相关证据：一些在基准上得分近乎完美的 VLA 在物体或相机稍微移动时就会失败，并由此提出进一步的研究问题。

items.title_en: Unlocking Cross-Attention in Label-Scarce Regimes: A Weakly Supervised Approach for Video Semantic Segmentation
items.title_zh: 在标签稀缺情形下释放交叉注意力：一种用于视频语义分割的弱监督方法
items.abstract_en: Weakly Supervised Video Semantic Segmentation (WS-VSS) aims to learn temporally consistent semantic object masks in videos using only video-level labels. While fully supervised models successfully learn temporal relationships by means of cross-attention, training these temporal weights under weak supervision is unstable and even pushes the model below its single-frame baseline. Therefore, existing WS-VSS methods exploit temporal consistency by relying on external priors, such as optical flow. Unfortunately these cues are non-semantic, computationally expensive and noisy, degrading the supervisory signal. Instead of supervising attention weights directly or using external priors, we propose MemCAM, a WS-VSS transformer framework that learns temporal cross-attention directly through feature-space self-supervision. MemCAM introduces a CAM Propagation Algorithm that synthesizes a supervisory signal by propagating past CAMs according to patch-level feature similarities in the latent space. Specifically, we constrain their induced CAMs through a consistency objective between predicted and propagated maps, stabilizing temporal attention learning. Experiments on the YouTube-Objects v2.2 and WS$^2$ datasets demonstrate that MemCAM consistently outperforms the temporal localization and segmentation performance of WS-VSS alternatives, showing that cross-attention can be effectively trained in label-scarce video settings through internal self-supervision.
items.abstract_zh: 弱监督视频语义分割（WS-VSS）旨在仅使用视频级标签学习视频中时间一致的语义对象掩码。虽然全监督模型通过交叉注意力成功学习了时间关系，但在弱监督下训练这些时间权重并不稳定，甚至会使模型低于其单帧基线。因此，现有 WS-VSS 方法依赖光流等外部先验来利用时间一致性。遗憾的是，这些线索是非语义的、计算昂贵且含噪的，会降低监督信号的质量。我们提出 MemCAM，这是一种 WS-VSS Transformer 框架，不直接监督注意力权重，也不使用外部先验，而是通过特征空间自监督直接学习时间交叉注意力。MemCAM 引入了 CAM 传播算法，该算法根据潜在空间中的块级特征相似度传播过去的 CAM，从而合成监督信号。具体而言，我们通过预测图与传播图之间的一致性目标来约束它们诱导的 CAM，从而稳定时间注意力学习。在 YouTube-Objects v2.2 和 WS$^2$ 数据集上的实验表明，MemCAM 在时间定位和分割性能上始终优于其他 WS-VSS 方法，表明交叉注意力可以通过内部自监督在标签稀缺的视频设置中被有效训练。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Protein Language Models Fail To Capture Contact Predictions Under Invariant Relabeling
items.title_zh: 蛋白质语言模型在不变重标号下无法复现接触预测
items.abstract_en: Protein language models (pLMs) produce highly accurate contact maps from single-sequence inputs. People often take this accuracy as proof that these models implicitly learn invariant coevolutionary statistics, extracting the same signals as classical alignment-based methods like Potts. In this work, we introduce a diagnostic framework around a global bijective relabeling of the amino-acid alphabet. This transformation permutes residue letters while leaving all alignment-level information, column entropies, and pairwise edit distances unchanged. Pseudolikelihood Potts models and inverse-covariance estimators remain invariant under this transformation, but pLMs fail the test. Across multiple architectures (ESM-2, MSA Transformer, AMPLIFY) and model scales (8M to 3B parameters), pLM contact maps collapse under arbitrary relabeling. Using Hamming distance controls and biochemical grouping interventions, we attempt to isolate what likely causes this degradation and find that these models rely on explicit, canonical residue identities (``alphabet anchoring'') rather than pure coevolutionary statistics. Increasing scale makes models more responsive to biochemical classes, but their performance still degrades under relabeling. Our findings show a gap between how pLMs and classical coevolutionary models compute contacts. More broadly, our work shows how diagnostic perturbations that leave classical models provably unchanged can expose hidden representation biases and prevent over-reliance on neural black boxes in biological modeling.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质语言模型（pLM）仅凭单序列输入即可给出高精度接触图，常被认为隐式学到了与 Potts 等比对方法相同的共进化统计。本文提出一个诊断框架，核心是对氨基酸字母表做全局双射重标号：置换残基字母，同时保持所有比对层信息、列熵与成对编辑距离不变。伪似然 Potts 模型与逆协方差估计在此变换下严格不变，pLM 却失败。在 ESM-2、MSA Transformer、AMPLIFY 等架构及 8M–3B 参数规模上，pLM 的接触图在任意重标号下均崩塌。借助 Hamming 距离对照与生化分组干预，作者发现模型依赖显式的规范残基身份（「字母锚定」），而非纯共进化统计；规模增大只提升对生化类别的敏感性，性能仍下降。
items.highlight_zh: 氨基酸重标号即可让蛋白质语言模型接触图崩塌
items.digest_zh:
· 研究问题：蛋白质语言模型只看单条序列就能画出高精度接触图，很多人据此认为它学到了与经典比对方法（如 Potts 模型）等价的共进化规律。真是这样吗？
· 方法：作者设计了一个「诊断性扰动」——对氨基酸字母表整体做一一对应的重标号（相当于把 20 种残基的字母重新洗牌）。这一步不改变任何比对层面的信息、列熵和成对编辑距离，因此 Potts 伪似然模型和逆协方差估计这类经典方法在数学上可证明结果不变。
· 结果：pLM 却没通过测试。在 ESM-2、MSA Transformer、AMPLIFY 等架构、8M 到 3B 参数范围内，只要残基被任意重标号，接触图质量就明显崩塌。作者进一步用 Hamming 距离对照和按生化性质分组的干预来定位原因，发现模型其实依赖「残基的具体身份」，即所谓字母锚定，而不是纯粹的共进化统计。加大规模只让模型对生化类别更敏感，重标号下性能照样下滑。
· 为何重要：这说明 pLM 与经典共进化模型在「如何算出接触」上存在机制差异；也示范了一种思路——用对经典模型可证不变的扰动去探查神经黑箱的隐藏偏差，避免在生物建模中过度依赖不可解释的模型。

items.title_en: Optical Representation Neural Networks Enabled by Weakly Supervised Learning
items.title_zh: 由弱监督学习实现的光学表征神经网络
items.abstract_en: Diffractive optical neural networks (ONNs) show remarkable promise in high-speed and energy-efficient optical computing. However, most existing ONNs are optimized to reproduce predefined output intensity distributions, with the desired optical responses explicitly specified before training. Here, we introduce optical representation neural networks (ORNNs) enabled by coarse-grained weak supervision. Using handwritten Devanagari, Arabic, and English characters as three semantic groups, a modified contrastive objective encourages samples from the same script to cluster into similar optical representations. Remarkably, ORNNs improve the classification accuracy by approximately 9% over conventional supervised ONNs, while requiring only around 18% of the training steps to reach a stable test accuracy of 84.5%. These features can be selectively interpreted using corresponding semantic decoders. Building on this concept, we further realized semantic optical encryption with electronic neural network (ENN) decryption using experimentally acquired representations from a single-layer diffractive network fabricated by two-photon polymerization lithography (TPL). Here, we combine information from different scripts into a mixed optical ciphertext that is then first optically classified before being decrypted with a matched ENN. This work broadens the training paradigm of ONNs by coupling upstream optical representation learning with downstream task-specific decoding, opening new avenues for optical information processing.
items.abstract_zh: 衍射光学神经网络（ONN）在高速、节能的光学计算中展现出显著前景。然而，大多数现有 ONN 被优化以重现预定义的输出强度分布，期望的光学响应在训练前被明确指定。在此，我们引入了由粗粒度弱监督实现的光学表征神经网络（ORNN）。使用手写的天城文、阿拉伯文和英文字符作为三个语义组，一种改进的对比目标鼓励来自同一文字的样本聚类为相似的光学表征。值得注意的是，与传统的监督 ONN 相比，ORNN 将分类准确率提高约 9%，同时仅需约 18% 的训练步数即可达到 84.5% 的稳定测试准确率。这些特征可以使用相应的语义解码器进行选择性解释。在这一概念的基础上，我们进一步利用由双光子聚合光刻（TPL）制备的单层衍射网络实验获取的表征，实现了语义光学加密与电子神经网络（ENN）解密。在此，我们将来自不同文字的信息组合成混合光学密文，然后先对其进行光学分类，再用匹配的 ENN 解密。这项工作通过将上游光学表征学习与下游任务特定解码相耦合，拓宽了 ONN 的训练范式，为光学信息处理开辟了新途径。

items.title_en: WeatherDreamer: Learning a World Model from Multimodal Earth Observations
items.title_zh: WeatherDreamer：从多模态地球观测中学习世界模型
items.abstract_en: Machine learning weather models now rival operational global forecasts but still start from analyses produced by separate, expensive data assimilation (DA) systems, which for global models are typically updated every six hours. Observation-to-observation models avoid this dependence, but most omit the recursive filtering cycle that lets DA systems carry a background state through sparse, irregular observations. We introduce WeatherDreamer, a world model that learns this cycle end-to-end from 18 global observing systems, without reanalysis. It infers a latent state from observations, carries it forward hour by hour with learned dynamics, corrects it each hour with new observations, and can predict what any of its observing systems would measure at any location. At held-out stations, its ensembles beat NOAA's Global Ensemble Forecast System (GEFS) for temperature, dew point and wind out to 12 h and are better calibrated than GEFS and the ECMWF ensemble. Precipitation, cloud-top height and solar irradiance, never inputs at inference, are inferred with skill matching or exceeding operational products at short leads. Against the first guess of NOAA's Gridpoint Statistical Interpolation (GSI) DA system, WeatherDreamer's short-range departures are within 10% of GSI's at surface stations and within 25% for moisture-sensitive microwave channels, but up to five times larger for temperature-sounding channels. Never given observation errors, its learned update assumes errors close to known instrument and retrieval errors of microwave sounders and scatterometer winds. WeatherDreamer also separates viewing geometry from atmospheric state, recovering 83-96% of observed limb darkening and producing seamless nadir-view imagery. Producing an hourly global analysis in about 1.5 minutes on one GPU, WeatherDreamer shows that assimilation and forecasting can be learned together directly from observations.
items.abstract_zh: 机器学习天气模型如今已可与业务全球预报相匹敌，但仍从由单独且昂贵的数据同化（DA）系统生成的分析场出发；对于全球模式，这些分析场通常每六小时更新一次。观测到观测模型避免这种依赖，但大多数省略了递归滤波循环，而正是该循环使DA系统能够通过稀疏、不规则观测携带背景状态。我们提出WeatherDreamer，一种直接从18个全球观测系统端到端学习该循环的世界模型，且不使用再分析资料。它从观测中推断潜在状态，用学习到的动力学逐小时将其向前传递，每小时用新观测对其进行校正，并能预测其任一观测系统在任意位置会测到什么。在留出站点上，其集合预报在温度、露点和风方面到12小时优于NOAA全球集合预报系统（GEFS），且校准优于GEFS和ECMWF集合。降水、云顶高度和太阳辐照度在推理时从未作为输入，却在短预报时效内以匹配或超过业务产品的技巧被推断出来。相对于NOAA格点统计插值（GSI）DA系统的初猜场，WeatherDreamer的短程偏差在地面站处于GSI的10%以内，对湿度敏感微波通道处于25%以内，但对温度探测通道高达五倍。尽管从未给定观测误差，其学习到的更新假设的误差接近微波探测器和散射计风的已知仪器误差与反演误差。WeatherDreamer还将观测几何与大气状态分离，恢复了83–96%的观测临边昏暗，并生成无缝天底视角图像。在单个GPU上约1.5分钟生成逐小时全球分析，WeatherDreamer表明同化和预报可以直接从观测中一起学习。

items.title_en: Securing Multi-Agent Systems by Design
items.title_zh: 通过设计保障多智能体系统安全
items.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems solve complex tasks by decomposing them into subtasks, delegating the subtasks to agents, and aggregating the agents' responses using an aggregation rule. Malicious agents can manipulate the final solution by providing malicious responses to their assigned subtasks. In this paper, we first propose response manipulation attacks (ReMA), which iteratively optimize malicious responses to maximize attack effectiveness. Specifically, we formulate untargeted and targeted attacks as optimization problems and develop an approach to approximately solve these problems by iteratively refining malicious responses based on feedback from a surrogate multi-agent system. To defend against such attacks, we further propose SecMAS, a secure aggregation rule that leverages the semantic similarities among agent responses to select the response that is most consistent with a sufficiently large subset of the other responses. We theoretically establish security guarantees for SecMAS against both untargeted and targeted attacks. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that existing aggregation rules are vulnerable to ReMA, whereas SecMAS effectively defends against all evaluated attacks, including adaptive variants of ReMA, while maintaining utility comparable to that of existing aggregation rules.
items.abstract_zh: 多智能体系统通过将复杂任务分解为子任务、把子任务委派给智能体，并使用聚合规则聚合智能体响应来求解复杂任务。恶意智能体可以通过对其分配的子任务提供恶意响应来操纵最终解。本文首先提出响应操纵攻击（ReMA），该攻击迭代优化恶意响应以最大化攻击效果。具体而言，我们将无目标攻击和有目标攻击表述为优化问题，并开发一种通过基于代理多智能体系统的反馈迭代精炼恶意响应来近似求解这些问题的方法。为防御此类攻击，我们进一步提出SecMAS，一种安全聚合规则，利用智能体响应之间的语义相似性，选择与其他响应的足够大子集最一致的响应。我们从理论上建立SecMAS针对无目标攻击和有目标攻击的安全保障。大量评估表明，现有聚合规则易受ReMA攻击，而SecMAS能有效防御所有评估的攻击，包括ReMA的自适应变体，同时保持与现有聚合规则相当的效用。

items.title_en: Objectives as Policies: Vision-Language Model Cost Programs for Contact-Rich Manipulation
items.title_zh: 目标即策略：面向接触丰富操作的视觉-语言模型成本程序
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong semantic and spatial reasoning capabilities in 3D environments. Recently, connecting VLMs with model-predictive controllers (MPC) has emerged as a paradigm for combining strong semantic reasoning with physics-based planning. However, connecting these two for contact-rich robotic manipulation requires a task representation that bridges the two and captures how physical interactions can be reasoned by VLMs. In this work, we introduce Objectives as Policies (OaP), a framework that connects a pretrained VLM to a shared sampling-based MPC through an editable objective program. Each program specifies a sequence of stages for completing a task, combining running and terminal costs from a cost library with stage completion conditions. Given a natural-language task instruction and scene observation, we build a simulation-based digital twin through real-to-sim, and the VLM generates an objective program that is executed by the MPC in the simulation. The program is iteratively updated by the VLM based on MPC rollouts, before being deployed in the real world. We evaluate our framework in both simulation and the real world on four tabletop manipulation tasks, and show that it outperforms strong baselines. Additional videos and examples are available on the project website: https://zihaolu001.github.io/oap-project/
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）已在三维环境中展现出强大的语义和空间推理能力。近期，将VLM与模型预测控制器（MPC）连接已成为结合强语义推理与基于物理的规划的范式。然而，将二者连接用于接触丰富的机器人操作，需要一种能够桥接二者并刻画VLM如何推理物理交互的任务表示。在这项工作中，我们提出目标即策略（OaP），一个通过可编辑目标程序将预训练VLM连接到共享的基于采样的MPC的框架。每个程序指定完成任务的一系列阶段，将来自成本库的运行成本和终端成本与阶段完成条件相结合。给定自然语言任务指令和场景观测，我们通过真实到仿真构建基于仿真的数字孪生，VLM生成目标程序，并由MPC在仿真中执行。该程序由VLM基于MPC推演迭代更新，之后部署到真实世界。我们在仿真和真实世界中在四个桌面操作任务上评估该框架，并表明其优于强基线。更多视频和示例见项目网站：https://zihaolu001.github.io/oap-project/

items.title_en: TelePhysica: Agentic Reconstruction of Physically Interactive Scenes
items.title_zh: TelePhysica：物理交互场景的智能体重建
items.abstract_en: Direct image-to-video diffusion models entangle pixel synthesis with implicit latent motion, precluding persistent 3D mechanical equilibrium, mid-rollout intervention, and counterfactual force control. Conversely, single-pass programmatic 3D reconstruction from an uncalibrated photograph leaves monocular depth and support clearance underconstrained, causing reconstructed scenes to interpenetrate or collapse under gravity. We present TelePhysica, a closed-loop framework that reconstructs an executable, multi-regime physical world from a single photograph to drive stateful 3D interaction and trajectory-grounded video synthesis. A vision-language coding agent synthesizes separable visual meshes and declarative physical models within a two-stage verification loop that pairs pixel-aligned silhouette critique with a zero-force gravitational equilibrium preflight. The verified world compiles into a unified solver coupling rigid bodies, articulated chains, co-dimensional cloth shells, and 3D tetrahedral elastodynamics, whose simulated rollouts condition pretrained video diffusion models through pixel-aligned structural streams. On a 100-scene single-image benchmark, closed-loop execution raises equilibrium-verified world recovery from $0\%$ in single-pass synthesis to $81\%$. Controlled constitutive ablations show over an order-of-magnitude larger localized corner displacement and out-of-plane pleating in finite-element cloth than in matched rigid-plate proxies. Conditioning video diffusion on simulated trajectories increases dynamic motion-mask overlap by $2{\times}\text{--}5{\times}$ and preserves motion direction under counterfactual force reversals where direct image-to-video models fail.
items.abstract_zh: 直接的图像到视频扩散模型将像素合成与隐式潜在运动纠缠在一起，排除了持续的三维机械平衡、推演中途干预和反事实力控制。相反，从无标定照片进行单遍程序化三维重建会使单目深度和支撑间隙欠约束，导致重建场景相互穿透或在重力下坍塌。我们提出TelePhysica，一个闭环框架，可从单张照片重建可执行的多机制物理世界，以驱动有状态的三维交互和以轨迹为基础的视频合成。一个视觉-语言编码智能体在两阶段验证循环中合成可分离视觉网格和声明式物理模型，该循环将像素对齐的轮廓评判与零力重力平衡预检配对。经验证的世界编译为统一求解器，耦合刚体、铰接链、同维布料壳和三维四面体弹性动力学，其仿真推演通过像素对齐的结构流对预训练视频扩散模型进行条件化。在100场景单图像基准上，闭环执行将平衡验证的世界恢复率从单遍合成的0%提高到81%。受控本构消融显示，有限元布料中的局部角位移和面外褶皱比匹配的刚性板代理大一个数量级以上。以仿真轨迹对视频扩散进行条件化，将动态运动掩码重叠提高2–5倍，并在直接图像到视频模型失败的反事实力反转下保持运动方向。

items.title_en: Pyramidal Columns Acting as Attention Heads
items.title_zh: 锥体柱作为注意力头
items.abstract_en: Can the functional architecture of a Transformer attention head be given a biological construction? More specifically, could a suitable group of pyramidal columns in posterior temporal language regions (PTLRs) constitute the biological construction of a neuromorphic mechanical realization of an attention head, under a mathematical instantiation that need not coincide with its standard Transformer instantiation? This paper investigates this hypothesis by examining possible correspondences between the functional organization of attention heads and neurophysiological mechanisms operating within and across pyramidal columns involved in human language processing. Our analysis builds on a mechanical-structural description of Transformer attention heads as systems of simple neural networks linked through output-input and output-weight interconnections. We examine the functional organization of an attention head and the input-dependent transformations it produces, and ask how the corresponding processing relations could be constructed in biological neural tissue. We then identify candidate neural mechanisms of signal transmission and modulation within and across pyramidal columns that may jointly support such a construction. On this basis, we propose that a suitably organized group of pyramidal columns in PTLRs could constitute a biological construction of a neuromorphic mechanical realization of an attention head. Whether the required functional organization actually exists in PTLRs remains an open empirical question. The hypothesis does not require the biological system to reproduce the standard mathematical instantiation of Transformer attention: the same functional architecture may be mechanically realized and mathematically instantiated in a different way, consistent with its biological construction.
items.abstract_zh: 能否为 Transformer 注意力头的功能架构给出一种生物学构造？更具体地说，在一种无需与标准 Transformer 实例化相一致的数学实例化下，后颞叶语言区（PTLR）中一组合适的锥体柱能否构成注意力头的神经形态机械实现的生物学构造？本文通过考察注意力头的功能组织与参与人类语言处理的锥体柱内部及跨锥体柱运作的神经生理机制之间可能存在的对应关系，来研究这一假设。我们的分析建立在一种机械-结构描述之上：将 Transformer 注意力头描述为通过输出-输入和输出-权重互连连接的简单神经网络系统。我们考察注意力头的功能组织及其产生的依赖输入的变换，并追问相应的处理关系如何在生物神经组织中构建。随后，我们识别出锥体柱内部及跨锥体柱的信号传输与调制的候选神经机制，这些机制可能共同支持这种构建。在此基础上，我们提出，PTLR 中一组组织适当的锥体柱可以构成注意力头的神经形态机械实现的生物学构造。所需的功能组织是否实际存在于 PTLR 中，仍是一个开放的经验问题。该假设不要求生物系统复现 Transformer 注意力的标准数学实例化：同一功能架构可以以不同方式进行机械实现和数学实例化，并与其生物学构造相一致。

items.title_en: Digital Coherent Twin-Field Quantum Key Distribution with Gaussian-Modulated Coherent States
items.title_zh: 采用高斯调制相干态的数字相干孪生场量子密钥分发
items.abstract_en: Quantum key distribution (QKD) enables information-theoretically secure key sharing between two distant parties. Recently, one promising QKD protocol which can distribute a secret key over long distances called twin-field QKD (TF-QKD) has been developed. However, it requires active compensation for experimental imperfections such as phase, polarization, and frequency fluctuations with expensive devices and this makes its experimental implementation challenging. Here, we propose a long-distance continuous-variable QKD (CV-QKD) protocol which is inspired by TF-QKD. Our protocol can remove these requirements by using Gaussian-modulated coherent states and digital signal processing which is widely used in recent digital coherent optical communication and experimental implementations of CV-QKD. For security analysis, we use a numerical optimization approach with a photon-number cutoff assumption. We propose a new set of constraints for numerical optimization which can efficiently constrain a highly non-Gaussian quantum state shared by two legitimate parties in our protocol. We show that the key rate of our protocol exceeds the key rate of a direct-transmission CV-QKD protocol at long distances and it can overcome the repeaterless bound.
items.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（QKD）使两个相距遥远的一方能够以信息论安全的方式共享密钥。近期，一种有前景的QKD协议被开发出来，即能够在长距离上分发秘密密钥的孪生场QKD（TF-QKD）。然而，它需要使用昂贵设备对相位、偏振和频率波动等实验缺陷进行主动补偿，这使其实验实现具有挑战性。在此，我们提出一种受TF-QKD启发的长距离连续变量QKD（CV-QKD）协议。我们的协议通过使用高斯调制相干态和数字信号处理能够移除这些要求，数字信号处理广泛用于近期数字相干光通信和CV-QKD的实验实现。对于安全性分析，我们使用带光子数截断假设的数值优化方法。我们提出一组新的数值优化约束，能够高效约束我们协议中两个合法方共享的高度非高斯量子态。我们表明，在长距离上，我们协议的密钥率超过直接传输CV-QKD协议的密钥率，并且能够克服无中继界限。

items.title_en: Linear Dynamic Range Extension for Rydberg Atomic Receiver via Band-Limited Reconstruction
items.title_zh: 通过带限重建扩展里德堡原子接收机的线性动态范围
items.abstract_en: Rydberg-atom receiver offers a promising approach to radio-frequency (RF) signal reception in wireless communication and sensing systems, combining high sensitivity with the potential for broad frequency coverage. However, the limited linear dynamic range (LDR) of the atomic system causes nonlinear distortion at high input signal levels, thereby restricting the receiver's effective linear input range. To address this issue, we analyze the mechanisms underlying nonlinear distortion in Rydberg atomic receivers and propose a physics-informed band-limited iterative reconstruction (PI-BLIR) method. Specifically, by exploiting the known nonlinear atomic response and signal bandwidth prior, we formulate a constrained maximum-likelihood problem to reconstruct the distorted complex intermediate-frequency (IF) waveform. With the bandwidth constraint absorbed into the frequency-domain parameterization, the constrained maximum-likelihood problem is transformed into an unconstrained optimization problem, which is solved using gradient descent. The proposed method relies solely on digital post-processing and requires no changes to the local-oscillator (LO) field strength, optical parameters, or atomic operating conditions. Simulation results demonstrate that PI-BLIR extends the receiver's LDR by more than 14 dB and enhances the demodulation performance of the atomic receiver.
items.abstract_zh: 里德堡原子接收机为无线通信和传感系统中的射频（RF）信号接收提供了一种有前景的方法，兼具高灵敏度和宽频率覆盖潜力。然而，原子系统有限的线性动态范围（LDR）会在高输入信号电平下造成非线性失真，从而限制接收机的有效线性输入范围。为解决这个问题，我们分析里德堡原子接收机中非线性失真的机制，并提出一种物理信息带限迭代重建（PI-BLIR）方法。具体而言，通过利用已知的非线性原子响应和信号带宽先验，我们构建一个约束最大似然问题来重建失真的复中频（IF）波形。将带宽约束吸收到频域参数化中后，约束最大似然问题被转化为无约束优化问题，并使用梯度下降求解。所提方法仅依赖数字后处理，无需改变本振（LO）场强、光学参数或原子工作条件。仿真结果表明，PI-BLIR将接收机的LDR扩展超过14 dB，并增强原子接收机的解调性能。

items.title_en: Benchmarks Don't Talk Back: Learning Through Self-Disagreement
items.title_zh: 基准测试不会反驳：通过自我分歧学习
items.abstract_en: A benchmark usually measures a language model alone with a question, and deployment rarely looks like that: answers get contested, and models give up correct ones under counter-reasoning that is itself wrong. We show that what fails there is not a shortfall of accuracy but a capability in its own right -- knowing when to hold a position and when to yield to a better one -- which we call dialectical competence. It stands on first-answer accuracy without following from it: a model can be made materially better at answering and no better at this, and training for accuracy alone can drift against it. Nor can it be bought at inference, by self-reflection or by sampling more. Taking a cue from the dialectical tradition in philosophy, in which productive opposition arises within a position rather than being imposed on it from outside, we hypothesize that this capability can be trained from opposition the model supplies itself. It states a position, generates the strongest case against that position -- its antithesis -- rules on whether the case stands, and is trained on that ruling, with no second model at training or at deployment. We call this learning through Self-Disagreement: reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards throughout, where the same check that scores an answer against its reference scores the ruling too, so no reward model, no preference data and no human annotation enter anywhere. The capability is trained rather than elicited: weak in the base model, it arrives with the reward, is not paid for out of first-answer accuracy, and holds against challengers the model never trained against, including ones stronger than itself. The opposition a model needs in order to improve, it turns out, need not come from outside it.
items.abstract_zh: 基准测试通常只用一个问题单独衡量语言模型，而部署场景很少如此：答案会受到质疑，模型会在本身错误的逆向推理下放弃正确答案。我们表明，那里失败的并非准确率不足，而是一种独立的能力——知道何时坚持某个立场、何时让位于更好的立场——我们称之为辩证能力。它以首答准确率为基础，但并不由后者推出：一个模型可以在回答上显著变得更好，却在这项能力上毫无提升；仅针对准确率进行训练也可能使其朝不利方向漂移。它也无法在推理时通过自我反思或更多采样获得。受哲学辩证传统的启发——其中富有成效的对立产生于某一立场内部，而非从外部强加于该立场——我们假设这种能力可以通过模型自身提供的对立面来训练。模型陈述一个立场，生成反对该立场的最强论据——即其反题——裁定该论据是否成立，并基于该裁定接受训练，训练和部署时均不需要第二个模型。我们称此为通过自我分歧学习：全程使用可验证奖励的强化学习，其中用于依据参考答案给答案打分的同一检查也给裁定打分，因此任何地方都不引入奖励模型、偏好数据或人工标注。该能力是训练出来的，而非诱导出来的：在基座模型中很弱，它随奖励而出现，不以首答准确率为代价，并且能抵御模型从未训练对抗过的挑战者，包括强于自身的挑战者。事实证明，模型为了提升所需要的对立面，未必来自其外部。

items.title_en: HALO: Human-Aligned Data Collection for WhoLe-body MObile Manipulation
items.title_zh: HALO：面向全身移动操作的人类对齐数据采集
items.abstract_en: Learning whole-body mobile manipulation requires demonstrations that coordinate bimanual actions with locomotion across extended workspaces. However, existing interfaces trade off direct robot control, perception and action alignment, and natural operator mobility, making such demonstrations difficult to collect. We introduce HALO, a human-aligned data collection system for whole-body mobile manipulation. The system aligns the operator's perception and action space with the robot while preserving direct physical feedback and natural locomotion. Operators guide the robot end-effectors through kinesthetic teaching and move a low-resistance platform without the deployed mobile base while performing bimanual manipulation. This interface enables more natural whole-body demonstrations, but the close human-robot coupling introduces discrepancies between the demonstration and deployment settings. We address these discrepancies with deployment-aligned demonstration processing, which calibrates and temporally aligns platform motion with the deployed base response and masks and inpaints demonstrator hands in recorded observations. Compared with Mobile ALOHA and VR teleoperation, HALO enables up to 2.9x faster demonstration collection while maintaining comparable or higher success rates. Policies trained with HALO perform precise manipulation tasks, including zip-tie fastening, and achieve a 73.3% success rate on a six-stage long-horizon mobile manipulation task involving repeated coordinated base and arm motion. Project page: https://robbyant-research.github.io/Lingbot-ALOHA/
items.abstract_zh: 学习全身移动操作需要能够在扩展工作空间中协调双臂动作与移动的演示。然而，现有接口在直接机器人控制、感知与动作对齐以及操作者自然移动性之间进行权衡，使此类演示难以采集。我们介绍 HALO，一种面向全身移动操作的人类对齐数据采集系统。该系统将操作者的感知与动作空间与机器人对齐，同时保留直接的物理反馈和自然移动。操作者通过动觉教学引导机器人末端执行器，并在执行双臂操作时移动一个低阻力平台，而非部署所用的移动底座。该接口能够实现更自然的全身演示，但紧密的人机耦合会在演示与部署设置之间引入差异。我们通过面向部署的演示处理来解决这些差异：将平台运动与部署底座的响应进行校准和时间对齐，并在记录的观测中对演示者的手部进行掩膜和修复。与 Mobile ALOHA 和 VR 遥操作相比，HALO 将演示采集速度最高提升至 2.9 倍，同时保持相当或更高的成功率。使用 HALO 训练的策略可执行精细操作任务，包括扎带紧固，并在一个涉及底座与机械臂重复协调运动的六阶段长程移动操作任务上达到 73.3% 的成功率。项目页面：https://robbyant-research.github.io/Lingbot-ALOHA/

items.title_en: From Images to Grounded Edits: A Real-World Benchmark for Chinese Grammatical Error Correction in Handwritten Essays
items.title_zh: 从图像到定位编辑：手写作文中文语法错误纠正的真实世界基准
items.abstract_en: Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (CGEC) is typically formulated as a text-to-text problem. While suitable for digital texts, this formulation falls short in real-world K-12 education, where AI-assisted corrections are expected directly on essay images, which are primarily handwritten and exhibit many irregularities. To bridge this gap, we introduce Grounded Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (G-CGEC), an image-to-grounded-edit task requiring systems to predict both corrections and their positions on essay images. We propose G-CGEC-Eval, a benchmark comprising real-world images of K-12 Chinese essays with fine-grained annotations. For evaluation, we adapt IoU-based metrics from object detection and propose a more tolerant alternative based on center-distance matching. Using this benchmark, we evaluate open-source and proprietary vision-language models under a direct single-pass setting, as well as settings with auxiliary components (OCR and character grounding) coordinated via pipelining or agentic harnessing. Results show that even top-tier proprietary models perform surprisingly poorly in the single-pass setting, while pipelining and agentic harnessing yield meaningful improvements. Notably, an error-type-based multi-agent workflow achieves the best performance, establishing it as the strongest baseline for future G-CGEC research. Through ablations and fine-grained analysis, we find the task remains far from solved, with linguistic error discovery and character-level grounding as the primary bottlenecks. This underscores the need for models that better integrate visual perception with linguistic reasoning and visual grounding.
items.abstract_zh: 中文语法错误纠正（CGEC）通常被表述为文本到文本的问题。虽然这适用于数字文本，但在真实的 K-12 教育中，该表述存在不足，因为 AI 辅助纠正被期望直接作用于作文图像，而这些图像主要是手写的，并表现出许多不规则之处。为弥合这一差距，我们引入定位中文语法错误纠正（G-CGEC），这是一项图像到定位编辑的任务，要求系统同时预测纠正内容及其在作文图像上的位置。我们提出 G-CGEC-Eval，一个包含带有细粒度标注的真实 K-12 中文作文图像的基准。在评估方面，我们改编了目标检测中基于 IoU 的指标，并提出了一种基于中心距离匹配的更宽容替代指标。利用该基准，我们在直接单遍设置下，以及在通过流水线或智能体化利用来协调辅助组件（OCR 和字符定位）的设置下，评估了开源和专有视觉语言模型。结果表明，即使是顶级专有模型在单遍设置下也表现得出奇地差，而流水线和智能体化利用带来了有意义的改进。值得注意的是，一种基于错误类型的多智能体工作流取得了最佳性能，使其成为未来 G-CGEC 研究的最强基线。通过消融和细粒度分析，我们发现该任务仍远未解决，语言错误发现和字符级定位是主要瓶颈。这凸显了需要更好地将视觉感知与语言推理和视觉定位相结合的模型。

items.title_en: E2F4 gene therapy reverses established synaptic and cognitive deficits and remodels learning-associated signaling in Alzheimer's disease mice
items.title_zh: E2F4 基因治疗逆转阿尔茨海默病小鼠已建立的突触和认知缺陷，并重塑学习相关信号
items.abstract_en: Alzheimer's disease (AD) causes progressive synaptic dysfunction, neurodegeneration, and cognitive decline, yet strategies capable of reversing established deficits remain limited. Here, we show that neuronal expression of a p38MAPK phosphorylation-resistant human E2F4 variant (hE2F4DN), delivered by adeno-associated virus, restores hippocampal long-term potentiation and memory in homozygous 5xFAD mice after functional impairment is established. Treatment also reduces amyloid-{beta} and phospho-tau pathology and prevents hippocampal neuronal loss. Integrated proteomic and phosphoproteomic analyses reveal remodeling of metabolic, redox, neuroimmune, synaptic-vesicle, and GSK3{beta}-associated signaling pathways. Following contextual fear conditioning, hE2F4DN-treated mice exhibit broader learning-associated synaptic proteomic signatures and distinct phosphoregulatory responses involving synaptic machinery. These findings demonstrate that E2F4 gene therapy can reverse established synaptic and cognitive deficits while preserving neuronal integrity and reshaping molecular responses to learning, identifying E2F4 phosphorylation as a potential therapeutic target for advanced AD states.
items.abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）导致进行性突触功能障碍、神经退行和认知衰退，但能够逆转已建立缺陷的策略仍然有限。在此，我们表明，通过腺相关病毒递送神经元表达的抗 p38MAPK 磷酸化的人 E2F4 变体（hE2F4DN），在纯合 5xFAD 小鼠功能损伤建立后恢复海马长时程增强和记忆。治疗还减少淀粉样蛋白-β 和磷酸化 tau 病理，并防止海马神经元丢失。整合蛋白质组和磷酸化蛋白质组分析揭示代谢、氧化还原、神经免疫、突触囊泡和 GSK3β 相关信号通路的重塑。在情境恐惧条件反射后，hE2F4DN 治疗的小鼠表现出更广泛的学习相关突触蛋白质组特征，以及涉及突触机器的独特磷酸化调控反应。这些发现表明，E2F4 基因治疗可以逆转已建立的突触和认知缺陷，同时保持神经元完整性并重塑对学习的分子反应，将 E2F4 磷酸化确定为晚期 AD 状态的潜在治疗靶点。

items.title_en: Antihelical Edge States in Photonic Metacrystals
items.title_zh: 光子超晶中的反螺旋边缘态
items.abstract_en: Antihelical edge states represent a gapless form of boundary transport in which modes with opposite spin counterpropagate along a given boundary, while modes sharing the same spin propagate in the same direction on opposite boundaries. Here we show that such states arise naturally within a modified Kane-Mele framework realized in an electromagnetic-dual photonic metacrystal with staggered bianisotropy. Reversing the spin-dependent next-nearest-neighbor coupling on one sublattice reorganizes the bulk spectrum into a spin-polarized Dirac semimetal characterized by spin-dependent energy shifts of the Dirac cones rather than a bulk gap. This bulk reorganization generates tilted edge-mode dispersions in zigzag ribbons and gives rise to antihelical edge transport coexisting with bulk states. Full-wave simulations confirm the corresponding bulk and edge behaviors. Extending the analysis to finite geometries, simulations further reveal discrete corner-localized modes. A realistic design based on split-ring metaatoms is proposed to realize the required staggered bianisotropy and spin-dependent energy shifts of the Dirac cones. Furthermore, we show that the tensorial freedom of the bianisotropic constitutive relations enables continuous manipulation of the electromagnetic pseudospin basis while preserving the antihelical boundary transport. These results provide a practical route for engineering unconventional gapless boundary transport in photonic Dirac systems.
items.abstract_zh: 反螺旋边缘态代表一种无能隙的边界输运形式，其中自旋相反的模沿给定边界反向传播，而具有相同自旋的模在相对边界上沿同一方向传播。在此，我们表明此类态自然地出现在一个修改的 Kane-Mele 框架内，该框架在具有交错双各向异性的电磁对偶光子超晶中实现。在一个子晶格上反转自旋依赖的次近邻耦合，会将体谱重组为自旋极化的狄拉克半金属，其特征是狄拉克锥的自旋依赖能量偏移，而非体带隙。这种体相重组在锯齿带中产生倾斜的边缘模色散，并产生与体态共存的反螺旋边缘输运。全波仿真证实了相应的体和边缘行为。将分析扩展到有限几何结构，仿真进一步揭示了离散的角局域模。提出了一种基于开口环超原子的现实设计，以实现所需的交错双各向异性和狄拉克锥的自旋依赖能量偏移。此外，我们表明双各向异性本构关系的张量自由度能够连续操控电磁赝自旋基，同时保持反螺旋边界输运。这些结果为在光子狄拉克系统中工程化非常规无能隙边界输运提供了一条实用途径。

items.title_en: DeltaVisionX: A Low-Cost Vision-Guided Automation System Using YOLOv11 and PLC-Based Actuation
items.title_zh: DeltaVisionX：一种使用 YOLOv11 和基于 PLC 驱动的低成本视觉引导自动化系统
items.abstract_en: This paper presents DeltaVisionX, a low-cost industrial automation system that integrates real-time computer vision with PLC-based actuation for object classification and sorting. The system uses the YOLOv11 (You Only Look Once) deep learning model to detect objects on an operating conveyor belt and communicates detection results to a Delta DVP-SE PLC, which actuates pneumatic pistons for sorting. A custom dataset was created, labeled, and augmented to train the YOLOv11 model, achieving a mean average precision of 0.97 with real-time inference of 100 ms per frame. Encoder-based tracking ensures reliable synchronization between detection and actuation, supporting a throughput of 80 objects per minute. Results show that affordable, locally developed automation can reduce labor dependency and improve manufacturing efficiency. The novelty of the proposed system lies in its encodersynchronized vision-PLC integration rather than in the detection model itself. Future work includes integrating a highspeed Delta robot with EtherCAT-based servo control for advanced pick-and-place operations.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 DeltaVisionX，一种低成本工业自动化系统，它将实时计算机视觉与基于 PLC 的驱动相结合，用于对象分类和分拣。该系统使用 YOLOv11（You Only Look Once）深度学习模型检测运行中的传送带上的物体，并将检测结果传送给 Delta DVP-SE PLC，由后者驱动气动活塞进行分拣。创建、标注并增强了一个自定义数据集以训练 YOLOv11 模型，实现了 0.97 的平均精度均值，实时推理为每帧 100 ms。基于编码器的跟踪确保了检测与驱动之间的可靠同步，支持每分钟 80 个物体的吞吐量。结果表明，可负担的本地开发自动化能够降低对人工的依赖并提高制造效率。所提出系统的新颖性在于其编码器同步的视觉-PLC 集成，而非检测模型本身。未来工作包括集成带有基于 EtherCAT 伺服控制的高速 Delta 机器人，以执行高级取放操作。

items.title_en: Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate
items.title_zh: 学习扩散语言模型何时应重新生成
items.abstract_en: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model's own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3\% to 43.4\% at $1.9$-$3.5\times$ the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use $3.8$-$7.4\times$. It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.
items.abstract_zh: 重掩码允许扩散语言模型重新审视已生成文本，但有效校正需要知道何时修订以及修订什么。我们在数独上的诊断揭示了两个缺口。隐藏状态包含 token 置信度无法可靠暴露的错误信息，并且在周围上下文保持固定时，对孤立错误进行重掩码通常会重现该错误。这些发现促使我们提出 DiVR，一个预测部分生成的序列是否会达到正确答案的验证器。DiVR 在模型自身轨迹的最终正确性上训练，决定何时重新生成一个块以及保留哪个替代项，而生成器本身保持不变。在 LLaDA-8B-Base 的五个推理基准上，DiVR 以贪婪解码成本的 1.9–3.5 倍，将微调生成器的平均准确率从 35.3% 提升至 43.4%，高于使用 3.8–7.4 倍成本的搜索基线。它还与监督微调和强化学习等后训练互补，并泛化到其他生成器，包括 Dream。

items.title_en: X-Nav Technical Report: Real-World Long-Horizon Indoor-to-Outdoor Navigation on a Humanoid Robot
items.title_zh: X-Nav 技术报告：人形机器人真实世界室内到室外长程导航
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon navigation from indoors to outdoors remains an open problem for humanoid robots: one instruction covers rooms, doors and roads, and the camera moves with the gait. Worken, AGIBOT's measure of productive robot work, depends on robots that reach their workplaces autonomously. We present X-Nav, to our knowledge the first system to take a bipedal humanoid through a language-instructed long-horizon mission from indoors to outdoors. X-Nav covers a pipeline from data to deployment. Its data engine collects navigation data in open-source scenes, in digital twins of deployment sites and on real robots. Its navigation model, MELIOR, takes only RGB images from the robot's built-in camera and comes in two versions: MELIOR-A predicts actions, and MELIOR-N predicts a navigation goal. Its agentic workflow, X-Navarch, turns a brief human instruction into sub-tasks and deploys MELIOR on the robot with explicit target navigation and obstacle avoidance. On the Lingxi X2, X-Nav completes a mission of about a hundred metres from an office lobby to a store in a neighbouring building; LiDAR and odometry are used for target approach and low-level control. The mission is completed with both versions of MELIOR: the robot follows a change of destination and walks through a door from the lobby to the road, and with X-Navarch it also passes static and dynamic obstacles on the route. During deployment, MELIOR is adapted with data collected in a digital twin of the site; the adaptation raises its closed-loop success rate in the twin, and the adapted model is then deployed on the robot at the real site. In addition, MELIOR achieves competitive results on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.
items.abstract_zh: 从室内到室外的长程导航仍然是双足人形机器人的一个开放问题：一条指令涵盖房间、门和道路，且相机会随步态移动。Worken 是 AGIBOT 衡量机器人有效工作的指标，它依赖于机器人自主到达工作地点。我们提出 X-Nav，据我们所知，这是首个让双足人形机器人完成从室内到室外的语言指令长程任务的系统。X-Nav 涵盖从数据到部署的流水线。其数据引擎在开源场景、部署地点的数字孪生以及真实机器人上采集导航数据。其导航模型 MELIOR 仅接收来自机器人内置相机的 RGB 图像，并有两个版本：MELIOR-A 预测动作，MELIOR-N 预测导航目标。其智能体工作流 X-Navarch 将简短的人类指令转化为子任务，并在机器人上部署 MELIOR，进行明确的目标导航和避障。在 Lingxi X2 上，X-Nav 完成了一项约一百米的任务，从办公楼大厅到邻近建筑中的商店；LiDAR 和里程计用于目标接近和底层控制。任务在 MELIOR 的两个版本下均能完成：机器人跟随目的地变更，并穿过一扇门从大厅走到道路上；借助 X-Navarch，它还能通过路线上的静态和动态障碍物。在部署期间，MELIOR 使用在场地数字孪生中采集的数据进行适配；适配提高了其在孪生中的闭环成功率，随后适配后的模型被部署到真实场地的机器人上。此外，MELIOR 在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对传感器、标定、尺度与算力；重建画质和可用的定位精度属于不同指标。

items.title_en: Can Large Language Models Optimize Pretrained Neural Network Weights? A Multi-Phase Empirical Evaluation of Gradient-Free Editing in YOLO26 Object Detection
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型能否优化预训练神经网络权重？YOLO26目标检测中无梯度编辑的多阶段实证评估
items.abstract_en: Direct weight editing offers a gradient-free alternative to fine-tuning pretrained detectors, but its generalization and the value of large language model (LLM) guidance remain uncertain. We evaluate five experimental phases using YOLO26 models and MS COCO, comparing deterministic scaling, random perturbations, differential evolution, CMA-ES, structured interventions, real local-LLM proposals, failure-aware guidance, and hybrid LLM-CMA-ES against a matched random-policy control. Optimization uses native Ultralytics mAP50-95 on 1,000 COCO Val2017 images; selected candidates are assessed on a disjoint, previously examined 1,500-image subset, with COCO API AP50-95 reported separately where available. Increasing the CMA-ES budget from 8 to 250 evaluations raised development gains from +0.11 to +0.28 percentage points, while selection changes remained negative (-0.03 to -0.12 points); the 250-evaluation result uses one seed. The hybrid LLM approach showed no statistically established advantage over random-policy guidance (p = 0.612, 0.369, and 0.694 at budgets 8, 25, and 50). Five-seed YOLO26m replication yielded a COCO API AP difference of +0.004 points (95% CI: -0.026 to +0.034). Of 225 archived LLM proposals, 53 satisfy the final strict schema; early tensor-level execution cannot be fully verified. Genuine LLM-mediated weight editing is feasible, but the tested approaches did not demonstrate consistent transfer beyond the development subset or a measurable LLM advantage.
items.abstract_zh: 直接权重编辑为微调预训练检测器提供了一种无梯度替代方案，但其泛化性以及大型语言模型（LLM）指导的价值仍不确定。我们使用YOLO26模型和MS COCO评估五个实验阶段，将确定性缩放、随机扰动、差分进化、CMA-ES、结构化干预、真实的本地LLM提议、故障感知指导以及混合LLM-CMA-ES与匹配的随机策略对照进行比较。优化使用原生Ultralytics mAP50-95，在1,000张COCO Val2017图像上进行；选出的候选在互不重叠且此前已检查过的1,500张图像子集上评估，并在可获得时单独报告COCO API AP50-95。将CMA-ES预算从8次评估增加到250次评估，使开发集增益从+0.11个百分点提高到+0.28个百分点，而选择变化仍为负值（-0.03至-0.12个百分点）；250次评估的结果使用一个随机种子。混合LLM方法相对于随机策略指导未显示出统计上确立的优势（在预算8、25和50时，p = 0.612、0.369和0.694）。五种子YOLO26m复现得到的COCO API AP差异为+0.004个百分点（95% CI：-0.026至+0.034）。在225个归档的LLM提议中，53个满足最终严格模式；早期张量级执行无法完全验证。真正的LLM介导权重编辑是可行的，但所测试的方法未能在开发子集之外表现出一致的迁移或可测量的LLM优势。

items.title_en: Thermal variability and the geography of optimal temperature for child survival: childhood respiratory-infection mortality in 171 countries: a systematic analysis of the Global Burden of Disease Study 2023 and the C-LSAT high-resolution climate dataset
items.title_zh: 热变异性与儿童生存最优温度的地理分布：171个国家儿童呼吸道感染死亡率——对2023年全球疾病负担研究和C-LSAT高分辨率气候数据集的系统分析
items.abstract_en: Background In adults, cold-attributable mortality exceeds heat-attributable mortality roughly 17-fold. Child-specific evidence has begun to emerge only recently-a nationwide Brazilian case-crossover study located the minimum mortality temperature (MMT) for under-five deaths, and a 56-country survey-based analysis linked monthly temperature anomalies to under-five mortality-but no multi-country, climate-zone-resolved estimate of the childhood respiratory-infection MMT exists, and whether temperature variability is independently associated with childhood respiratory mortality at the global scale is unknown. We quantified both. Methods We combined Global Burden of Disease 2023 mortality estimates-lower respiratory infection (LRI) deaths at ages 0-19 years and asthma deaths at ages 0-24 years, 171 countries, 1990-2023-with 0.5 degree monthly land temperature and diurnal temperature range (DTR) fields from C-LSAT/C-LDTR (1901-2023). Four exposure dimensions (annual mean, DTR, seasonal amplitude, interannual variability) entered two-way fixed-effects models with Driscoll-Kraay standard errors. A quadratic term in mean temperature located the MMT, with percentile confidence intervals from a 300-replication country-cluster bootstrap. Future-exposure leads, country-level detrending, and permutation tests assessed contemporaneous causality, applied to both the linear coefficients and the quadratic term generating the MMT; national pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV3) coverage and ambient PM2.5 exposure series were added as time-varying mechanistic covariates. Country-level exposure changes for 2041-2060 were additionally projected under three CMIP6 SSP scenarios (WorldClim v2.1 baseline; MRI-ESM2-0) using a matched-cell delta method. Results The childhood LRI MMT was 17.1 degrees C (95% CI 14.7-19.8), the 36th percentile of the annual-temperature distribution; zone estimates were 24.7 degrees C in tropical and 15.8 degrees C in subtropical countries, with weak temperate and no subarctic identification. The quadratic term underpinning the MMT, however, failed both falsification checks-future temperatures reproduced the U-shape and country-level detrending erased it-so these MMT values describe a trend-level geographic pattern of the annual construct rather than a contemporaneous dose-response. Interannual temperature variability was positively associated with LRI (+0.278, 95% CI 0.102-0.454; p = 0.002) and asthma mortality (+0.836, 95% CI 0.447-1.226; p = 2.6 x 10-5) per 1 degree C, but future-exposure models returned nearly identical significant coefficients and detrending erased significance, supporting only a trend-level association; adjustment for national PCV3 coverage and PM2.5 exposure left these estimates essentially unchanged. Annual mean temperature was likewise inversely associated with both outcomes at the trend level; DTR and seasonal amplitude showed no independent within-country effects. Under all three scenarios, country-mean annual temperature is projected to rise by +1.6 to +2.4 degrees C by 2041-2060, with seasonal amplitude widening in 77-81% of the 196 projection polygons (a climate-raster set wider than the 171-country mortality panel). Conclusions This study provides the first multi-country, climate-zone-resolved geography of the optimal temperature for childhood respiratory survival, spanning 171 countries; because the underlying quadratic association is trend-level, the estimates are directional. The observed variability-mortality associations are trend-level signals rather than contemporaneous causal evidence; daily-scale, child-specific designs are required to determine whether short-term thermal variability affects paediatric respiratory mortality.
items.abstract_zh: 背景 在成人中，归因于寒冷的死亡率约为归因于高温的死亡率的17倍。儿童特异性证据直到最近才开始出现——一项巴西全国病例交叉研究确定了五岁以下儿童死亡的最低死亡温度（MMT），一项基于56个国家调查的分析将月温度异常与五岁以下儿童死亡联系起来——但尚不存在多国家、按气候区分辨的儿童呼吸道感染MMT估计，且在全球尺度上温度变异性是否与儿童呼吸道死亡率独立相关尚不清楚。我们量化了这两者。方法 我们将2023年全球疾病负担（GBD）死亡率估计——171个国家、1990—2023年0—19岁下呼吸道感染（LRI）死亡和0—24岁哮喘死亡——与C-LSAT/C-LDTR（1901—2023）的0.5度月陆地温度和昼夜温度范围（DTR）场相结合。四个暴露维度（年均值、DTR、季节振幅、年际变异性）进入带有Driscoll-Kraay标准误的双向固定效应模型。平均温度中的二次项用于定位MMT，百分位置信区间来自300次重复的国家聚类自助法。未来暴露超前项、国家层面去趋势和置换检验评估同期因果性，并应用于线性系数和生成MMT的二次项；国家肺炎球菌结合疫苗（PCV3）覆盖率和环境PM2.5暴露序列作为时变机制协变量加入。另在三种CMIP6 SSP情景下（WorldClim v2.1基线；MRI-ESM2-0），使用匹配单元delta方法预测2041—2060年国家层面暴露变化。结果 儿童LRI的MMT为17.1摄氏度（95% CI 14.7—19.8），位于年温度分布的第36百分位；热带国家估计为24.7摄氏度，亚热带国家为15.8摄氏度，温带识别较弱，亚寒带无识别。然而，支撑MMT的二次项未能通过两项证伪检验——未来温度再现了U形，国家层面去趋势消除了它——因此这些MMT值描述的是年度（平均温度）构造的趋势层面地理模式，而非同期剂量反应。年际温度变异性每1摄氏度与LRI（+0.278，95% CI 0.102—0.454；p = 0.002）和哮喘死亡率（+0.836，95% CI 0.447—1.226；p = 2.6×10⁻⁵）呈正相关，但未来暴露模型返回几乎相同的显著系数，而去趋势消除了显著性，仅支持趋势层面关联；对国家PCV3覆盖率和PM2.5暴露进行调整后，这些估计基本不变。年均温度同样在趋势层面与两种结局呈负相关；DTR和季节振幅未显示独立的国家内效应。在全部三种情景下，到2041—2060年，国家平均年均温度预计上升+1.6至+2.4摄氏度，196个投影多边形中有77%—81%的季节振幅扩大（该气候栅格集合宽于171个国家死亡率面板）。结论 本研究首次提供了覆盖171个国家的、按气候区分辨的儿童呼吸道生存最优温度地理分布；由于底层二次关联属于趋势层面，这些估计是方向性的。观察到的变异性—死亡率关联是趋势层面信号，而非同期因果证据；需要日尺度、儿童特异性设计来确定短期热变异性是否影响儿科呼吸道死亡率。

items.title_en: An Inverse-Designed Multilayer Selective Emitter for High-Efficiency Thermophotovoltaics
items.title_zh: 用于高效热光伏的逆向设计多层选择性发射器
items.abstract_en: High thermophotovoltaic (TPV) conversion efficiencies have typically relied on photovoltaic cells that reflect sub-bandgap radiation back toward the emitter. Here, we numerically investigate an alternative approach in which spectral selectivity is engineered primarily on the emitter side. We optimize an emitter consisting of 16-layer aperiodic MgO/Si coating on tungsten, for coupling to a GaSb cell with an antireflection coating and an Au mirror. A detailed-balance framework incorporates polarization- and angle-resolved emissivity, multiple reflections, and Auger nonradiative recombination. At an emitter temperature of 1500 K, the optimized structure suppresses 97.1% of the incident-blackbody-equivalent sub-bandgap power at the source; a further 1.9% is returned to the emitter by the cell, leaving 1.0% absorbed parasitically in the cell. The resulting modeled radiative-to-electrical conversion efficiency reaches 47.0%, compared with 30.8% for a SiC emitter paired with the same cell, while maintaining a comparable maximum electrical power density. These findings indicate that emitter-side spectral engineering could substantially relax cell-side photon-recycling requirements and provide significant improvement in TPV conversion.
items.abstract_zh: 高热光伏（TPV）转换效率通常依赖于将亚带隙辐射反射回发射器的光伏电池。在此，我们数值研究了一种替代方法，其中光谱选择性主要在发射器侧进行设计。我们优化了一种由钨上16层非周期MgO/Si涂层组成的发射器，用于与带有减反射涂层和Au反射镜的GaSb电池耦合。细致平衡框架纳入了偏振和角度分辨的发射率、多次反射以及Auger非辐射复合。在发射器温度为1500 K时，优化结构在源处抑制了97.1%的入射黑体等效亚带隙功率；另有1.9%由电池返回发射器，剩余1.0%被电池寄生吸收。由此建模得到的辐射到电转换效率达到47.0%，而与同一电池配对的SiC发射器为30.8%，同时保持相当的最大电功率密度。这些发现表明，发射器侧光谱工程可显著放宽电池侧光子回收要求，并显著改善TPV转换。

items.title_en: Classifier-Guided Latent Diffusion for Small-Molecule Generation
items.title_zh: 用于小分子生成的分类器引导潜扩散
items.abstract_en: Diffusion models have emerged as a promising class of generative models for molecular design because of their ability to learn complex chemical distributions and support conditional or guided generation. In this work, we investigate a latent diffusion pipeline for property-guided small-molecule generation. The proposed framework represents canonicalized SMILES strings using a frozen ChemBERTa encoder, trains a Transformer-based decoder to reconstruct SELFIES strings from molecular latent embeddings, and learns an unconditional denoising diffusion model in the ChemBERTa latent space. To enable property-directed generation, a differentiable latent property predictor is used to guide the diffusion sampling process. Generated SELFIES strings are converted to SMILES, validated using RDKit, and evaluated using molecular validity, uniqueness, novelty, and predicted property scores. We study guidance toward two drug-relevant binary endpoints: blood--brain barrier permeability and inhibition of human $β$-secretase 1. The results suggest that latent diffusion over pretrained molecular embeddings can generate chemically valid and novel molecules while enabling controllable steering toward desired molecular properties.
items.abstract_zh: 扩散模型已成为分子设计中一类有前景的生成模型，因为它们能够学习复杂化学分布并支持条件生成或引导生成。在本工作中，我们研究了一个用于性质引导小分子生成的潜扩散流程。所提出的框架使用冻结的ChemBERTa编码器表示规范化SMILES字符串，训练基于Transformer的解码器从分子潜在嵌入重建SELFIES字符串，并在ChemBERTa潜在空间中学习无条件去噪扩散模型。为实现性质导向生成，使用可微的潜在性质预测器来引导扩散采样过程。生成的SELFIES字符串被转换为SMILES，使用RDKit验证，并通过分子有效性、唯一性、新颖性和预测性质分数进行评估。我们研究朝两个药物相关二元终点的引导：血脑屏障通透性和人$β$-分泌酶1抑制。结果表明，在预训练分子嵌入上的潜扩散能够生成化学上有效且新颖的分子，同时能够朝向所需分子性质进行可控引导。

items.title_en: Morphological Simplification in Alzheimer's Disease: Computational Analysis and Identification From Connected Speech
items.title_zh: 阿尔茨海默病中的形态简化：基于连贯言语的计算分析与识别
items.abstract_en: Purpose: Morphology is often regarded as relatively spared in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and is rarely modeled in connected speech. This study asked which morphological features distinguish speakers with AD from healthy controls, how well morphology classifies AD compared with other linguistic levels and BERT-based models, and whether the signal exceeds transcript length and vocabulary. Method: Fifty-five automatic measures in eight families, seven of them new and theory-motivated, were computed from participant speech in the ADReSS Cookie Theft descriptions (78 AD, 78 controls) and analyzed with group comparisons, equivalence tests, SHAP, family ablation, likelihood-ratio tests, feature-selection classifiers, and BERT-based models. The automatic measures were validated manually, and models were transferred to two other corpora. Results: Nineteen of 38 measures differed between groups: speakers with AD produced fewer suffixed and inflected words, shorter verbs and nouns, and fewer present-progressive but more past-tense forms (largest effect r = -0.42), whereas errors were rare and statistically equivalent between groups. Eight measures survived adjustment for length and lexical frequency. With test-set feature selection, morphology reached a macro-F1 of 0.85, on par with syntax and above fine-tuned BERT (0.80 over five seeds); fully cross-validated selection gave 0.62. Adding morphology to BERT improved AUC (0.91 vs. 0.89) but not macro-F1. Transfer was limited, although two thirds of the effects kept their direction in mild cognitive impairment. Conclusions: AD connected speech shows morphological simplification and temporal reanchoring rather than breakdown. Morphology is more informative than its reputation suggests. Keywords: Alzheimer's disease; morphology; connected speech; ADReSS; inflection; tense and aspect; SHAP; machine learning; BERT
items.abstract_zh: 目的：形态学通常被认为在阿尔茨海默病（AD）中相对保留，且在连贯言语中很少被建模。本研究询问哪些形态特征能够区分 AD 说话者与健康对照，与其他语言层面和基于 BERT 的模型相比形态学对 AD 的分类效果如何，以及该信号是否超出转录文本长度和词汇量。方法：从 ADReSS Cookie Theft 描述中的参与者言语（78 名 AD，78 名对照）计算了八个类别中的 55 个自动测量指标，其中七个是新的且具有理论动机，并使用组间比较、等价检验、SHAP、类别消融、似然比检验、特征选择分类器和基于 BERT 的模型进行分析。自动测量指标经过人工验证，模型被迁移到另外两个语料库。结果：38 个测量指标中有 19 个在组间存在差异：AD 说话者产生更少带后缀和屈折的词、更短的动词和名词，以及更少的现在进行时但更多的过去时形式（最大效应 r = -0.42），而错误很少且在组间统计等价。八个测量指标在调整长度和词汇频率后仍然显著。在测试集特征选择下，形态学达到 macro-F1 0.85，与句法相当，并高于微调 BERT（五个随机种子平均 0.80）；完全交叉验证的选择得到 0.62。将形态学加入 BERT 改善了 AUC（0.91 对 0.89），但未改善 macro-F1。迁移有限，尽管三分之二的效应在轻度认知障碍中保持方向。结论：AD 连贯言语表现出形态简化和时间重新锚定，而非崩溃。形态学比其声誉所暗示的更具信息量。关键词：阿尔茨海默病；形态学；连贯言语；ADReSS；屈折；时态与体；SHAP；机器学习；BERT

items.title_en: Agentic-Teacher: An Agentic Data Engine for Failure-Driven VLA Post-Training
items.title_zh: Agentic-Teacher：面向失败驱动VLA后训练的代理式数据引擎
items.abstract_en: Improving a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model requires demonstrations that address its weaknesses and provide effective supervision for learning. Coding agents can autonomously generate demonstrations through environment interaction, yet successful execution alone does not ensure effective supervision for VLA learning. We introduce Agentic-Teacher, an autonomous data engine for failure-driven VLA post-training. Given a VLA checkpoint, a task specification, and configured environment tools, the engine analyzes failed rollouts, selects intervention states, and iteratively develops closed-loop code policies through execution feedback. Validated policies become reusable demonstration generators that collect successful continuations from states where the VLA struggles. To make these demonstrations suitable for learning, Agentic-Teacher introduces temporally correlated action noise to broaden state-action coverage, removes idle frames while preserving gripper transitions, and filters trajectories using the frozen base model's flow-matching loss. The resulting demonstrations are combined with successful VLA rollouts for post-training, yielding an updated policy that operates without coding-agent assistance. Agentic-Teacher thus connects the weaknesses of a target VLA to both the generation and curation of its training data. In simulation, it improves $π_0$ success rates from 79.4% to 87.8% on LIBERO-10, from 80.4% to 90.6% on MetaWorld-10, and from 0% to 30.0% across three RoboCasa tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 改进预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型需要能够针对其弱点并提供有效学习监督的示范。编码代理可以通过环境交互自主生成示范，但仅成功执行并不能确保对VLA学习提供有效监督。我们提出Agentic-Teacher，一种用于失败驱动VLA后训练的自主数据引擎。给定VLA检查点、任务规范和配置的环境工具，该引擎分析失败的轨迹执行，选择干预状态，并通过执行反馈迭代开发闭环代码策略。经验证的策略成为可复用的示范生成器，从VLA表现困难的状态收集成功的后续执行。为使这些示范适合学习，Agentic-Teacher引入时间相关的动作噪声以扩大状态-动作覆盖，移除空闲帧同时保留夹爪转换，并使用冻结基础模型的流匹配损失过滤轨迹。所得示范与成功的VLA轨迹执行结合用于后训练，产生一个无需编码代理协助即可运行的更新策略。因此，Agentic-Teacher将目标VLA的弱点与其训练数据的生成和筛选连接起来。在仿真中，它将$π_0$的成功率在LIBERO-10上从79.4%提高到87.8%，在MetaWorld-10上从80.4%提高到90.6%，并在三个RoboCasa任务上从0%提高到30.0%。

items.title_en: DuoJEPA: Cross-Modal Translation Between Unaligned Self-Supervised Embedding Spaces
items.title_zh: DuoJEPA：未对齐自监督嵌入空间之间的跨模态翻译
items.abstract_en: Learning from paired modalities is commonly equated with aligning them: two encoders are trained until the embeddings of a pair coincide in a shared space. We study whether cross-modal retrieval and classification can instead be obtained while the two encoders' own embedding spaces remain directly unaligned. DuoJEPA trains one encoder per modality with the self-supervised LeJEPA objective and appends to each encoder a single transformer layer that translates its embedding into the other encoder's space, supervised by a contrastive objective computed entirely within that target space. No loss term compares the two own spaces directly, although the encoders are optimised jointly through the translation objective. In our experiments, the translator's residual connections determine where the cross-modal pressure is absorbed: with a residual translator the two encoders become directly aligned, whereas with a skipless (residual-free) translator a paired-cosine test detects no alignment in the final models, and at most a weak one in the ablations, at comparable cross-modal performance. The learned class-token translation is well approximated by a single scaled rotation of the source space. We evaluate DuoJEPA on two modality pairs that differ in nearly every respect. On chest radiographs and reports from CheXpert Plus, it attains a zero-shot AUC of 86.6 and a cross-modal retrieval score of 78.5, compared with 60.0 and 64.2 for our reimplementation of LeVLJEPA with the same encoders and data. On Sentinel-2 optical and Sentinel-1 radar imagery, the frozen encoders fall within the range of published Sentinel foundation models under our reproduction of the Copernicus-Bench linear-probe protocol, the translator retrieves the paired image of the other sensor among 4,000 candidates in 77-79% of cases, and a patch-level extension transfers the within-image similarity structure of the scene.
items.abstract_zh: 从成对模态中学习通常被等同于对齐它们：训练两个编码器，直到一对嵌入在共享空间中重合。我们研究是否可以在两个编码器自身的嵌入空间保持直接未对齐的情况下，获得跨模态检索和分类。DuoJEPA 使用自监督 LeJEPA 目标为每种模态训练一个编码器，并在每个编码器后附加一个 transformer 层，将其嵌入翻译到另一个编码器的空间，该层由完全在该目标空间内计算的对比目标监督。没有损失项直接比较两个自身空间，尽管编码器通过翻译目标联合优化。在我们的实验中，翻译器的残差连接决定了跨模态压力被吸收的位置：使用残差翻译器时，两个编码器变得直接对齐；而使用无跳跃连接（无残差）翻译器时，配对余弦检验在最终模型中未检测到对齐，在消融实验中至多检测到弱对齐，同时跨模态性能相当。学到的类 token 翻译可以很好地由源空间的单个缩放旋转近似。我们在几乎各方面都不同的两个模态对上评估 DuoJEPA。在 CheXpert Plus 的胸部 X 光片和报告上，它达到 86.6 的零样本 AUC 和 78.5 的跨模态检索分数，而我们用相同编码器和数据重新实现的 LeVLJEPA 为 60.0 和 64.2。在 Sentinel-2 光学和 Sentinel-1 雷达影像上，在我们复现 Copernicus-Bench 线性探针协议下，冻结编码器落在已发表 Sentinel 基础模型的范围内；翻译器在 4,000 个候选中以 77-79% 的情况检索到另一传感器的配对图像；补丁级扩展迁移了场景的图像内相似性结构。

items.title_en: A single complex V2 as an alternative hypothesis for the organization of mouse higher visual cortex
items.title_zh: 单一复杂V2作为小鼠高级视觉皮层组织的一种替代假说
items.abstract_en: The mouse has become a major model for studies of the visual system, creating a need for principles of areal delineation that can be compared across species. In many well-studied mammals, V1 is bordered by a single second visual area, V2, whereas the cortex immediately surrounding mouse V1 is commonly parcellated into roughly eight higher-order visual areas (HVAs), with boundaries defined in part by reversals in the progression of the visual field. Work in other species has shown that such reversals can occur within a single visual area when retinotopic mapping is complex, raising the possibility that some conventionally defined mouse HVAs may instead be subdivisions of a single complex V2. We use simulations to show that complex retinotopy within a single visual area can generate multiple apparent areal borders beyond mouse V1. We also show that distinct biases in visual field representation among areas is a contributing factor to many of the reported functional differences among HVAs. Finally, our unified-V2 hypothesis makes several testable predictions, one of which is that functional differences between conventional HVAs need not exceed the variation within a single area. To test this prediction, we collected electrophysiological and two-photon recordings across V1's retinotopic map, providing a large-scale dataset that we are making publicly available with this study. Using this dataset, we examined response properties associated with visual cortical hierarchy and found that they clearly distinguished V1 from higher visual cortex, while variation among individual HVAs did not significantly exceed variation across sampled locations within V1. Together, these findings support the unified-V2 hypothesis as an alternative model of mouse higher visual cortex and emphasize the importance of converging topographic, functional, architectonic, and connectional evidence in defining cortical areas.
items.abstract_zh: 小鼠已成为视觉系统研究的主要模型，这产生了对可跨物种比较的脑区划分原则的需求。在许多研究充分的哺乳动物中，V1与单个第二视觉区V2相邻，而小鼠V1紧邻周围的皮层通常被划分为大约八个高阶视觉区（HVA），其边界部分由视野推进中的反转来定义。其他物种的工作表明，当视网膜拓扑映射复杂时，这种反转可发生在单个视觉区内，这提高了一种可能性：某些传统定义的小鼠HVA可能实际上是单个复杂V2的细分。我们使用模拟表明，单个视觉区内的复杂视网膜拓扑可在小鼠V1之外产生多个表观脑区边界。我们还表明，各区域间视野表征的不同偏置是许多已报道的HVA功能差异的一个促成因素。最后，我们的统一V2假说作出若干可检验预测，其中之一是传统HVA之间的功能差异不必超过单个区域内的变异。为检验这一预测，我们在V1的视网膜拓扑图上收集了电生理和双光子记录，提供了本研究随文公开的大型数据集。使用该数据集，我们检查了与视觉皮层层级相关的响应特性，发现它们清楚地将V1与高级视觉皮层区分开，而各个HVA之间的变异并未显著超过V1内采样位置之间的变异。总之，这些发现支持统一V2假说作为小鼠高级视觉皮层的一种替代模型，并强调在定义皮层区域时汇聚拓扑、功能、构筑和连接证据的重要性。

items.title_en: Resilient Transmission of Highly Structured Light via Active Convolved Illumination
items.title_zh: 通过主动卷积照明实现高度结构化光的鲁棒传输
items.abstract_en: Wave propagation through lossy and noisy systems as well as spatiotemporally dynamic random media often limits the complex information that can be reliably transmitted or retrieved. Progress in adaptive optics, wavefront shaping, machine learning, and wave propagation theories has significantly advanced physical and computational correction techniques. However, many approaches remain constrained by restrictive operating conditions, limiting their ability to meet growing application-specific demands, such as higher spatial resolution in imaging and greater data capacity in communications, particularly in highly dynamic environments. Recently, active convolved illumination (ACI) was proposed as a novel framework for preserving the spatial structure of optical modes during propagation through strongly distorting environments, such as atmospheric turbulence. ACI aims to bypass the prohibitive complexity of global distortion tracking by combining spectrally localized characterization with compensation using a correlated auxiliary source. Here, we provide a comprehensive review of ACI, detailing the formulation of correlation-injecting and auxiliary sources and the role of segmented reciprocal-space characterization and distortion compensation. We explore extensions in free-space optical communication and potential high-precision phase measurement, and numerically evaluate interferometric strategies for experimental implementation. This work highlights ACI as a potentially versatile framework for distortion-resilient light transmission, with broad interdisciplinary utility ranging from atmospheric physics and remote sensing to telecommunications, target tracking, and biomedical diagnosis, offering flexible deployment either as a standalone paradigm or hybridized with existing optical systems.
items.abstract_zh: 波在损耗和噪声系统以及时空动态随机介质中的传播，常常限制能够可靠传输或恢复的复杂信息。自适应光学、波前整形、机器学习和波传播理论的进展已显著推进了物理和计算校正技术。然而，许多方法仍受限于苛刻的工作条件，限制了它们满足日益增长的应用特定需求的能力，例如成像中更高的空间分辨率和通信中更大的数据容量，尤其是在高度动态环境中。最近，主动卷积照明（ACI）被提出作为一种新框架，用于在穿过强畸变环境（如大气湍流）传播期间保持光学模式的空间结构。ACI旨在通过将光谱局部化表征与使用相关辅助源的补偿相结合，绕过全局畸变跟踪的过高复杂性。在此，我们对ACI进行全面综述，详细说明相关性注入源和辅助源的构建，以及分段倒空间表征和畸变补偿的作用。我们探索其在自由空间光通信和潜在高精度相位测量中的扩展，并对用于实验实施的干涉策略进行数值评估。这项工作强调ACI作为一种具有潜在通用性的抗畸变光传输框架，具有从大气物理和遥感 to 电信、目标跟踪和生物医学诊断的广泛跨学科实用性，可作为独立范式或与现有光学系统混合部署。

items.title_en: Continuous Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation Using PPG From Methods to Clinical Translation
items.title_zh: 利用PPG的连续无袖带血压估计：从方法到临床转化
items.abstract_en: Continuous blood pressure (BP) monitoring could improve hypertension management by capturing changes that intermittent cuff measurements miss. Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely explored for cuffless BP estimation because optical sensors are inexpensive, wearable, and already present in many consumer and clinical devices. PPG, however, does not measure arterial pressure: BP is inferred from waveform characteristics or pulse timing, which also depend on vascular tone, arterial stiffness, sensor contact, motion, and individual physiology. This survey reviews PPG-based cuffless BP estimation along the full measurement chain, covering physiological mechanisms, waveform features, pulse arrival time (PAT), pulse transit time (PTT), machine-learning methods, datasets, calibration, validation, deployment, bias, and clinical translation. Studies are assessed by the strength of evidence they provide rather than by reported error alone, with particular attention to subject and temporal leakage, dataset imbalance, calibration dependence and drift, motion artifacts, and the gap between benchmark accuracy and reliable real-world measurement. The review finds that progress depends on more than better prediction algorithms. Future work should prioritize physiologically informed models, diverse longitudinal datasets, transparent reporting of calibration requirements and failure rates, stronger evaluation protocols, and studies that demonstrate practical value in clinical care.
items.abstract_zh: 连续血压（BP）监测可通过捕捉间歇性袖带测量遗漏的变化来改善高血压管理。光电容积脉搏波（PPG）因光学传感器成本低、可穿戴且已存在于许多消费和临床设备中，而被广泛探索用于无袖带血压估计。然而，PPG并不测量动脉压：血压是由波形特征或脉搏时序推断的，而这些也依赖于血管张力、动脉僵硬度、传感器接触、运动以及个体生理。本综述沿完整测量链回顾基于PPG的无袖带血压估计，涵盖生理机制、波形特征、脉搏到达时间（PAT）、脉搏传导时间（PTT）、机器学习方法、数据集、校准、验证、部署、偏倚和临床转化。研究依据其提供的证据强度而非仅依据报告误差进行评估，特别关注受试者和时间泄漏、数据集不平衡、校准依赖与漂移、运动伪影，以及基准准确性与可靠真实世界测量之间的差距。本综述发现，进展不仅取决于更好的预测算法。未来工作应优先考虑生理学知情模型、多样化纵向数据集、校准需求和失败率的透明报告、更强的评估协议，以及证明临床护理实际价值的研究。
