items.title_en: Pretraining Data Statistics Shape the Phases of Learning Entity Comparison in Language Models
items.title_zh: 预训练数据统计塑造语言模型中实体比较学习的阶段
items.abstract_en: How does data shape language model (LM) behavior throughout pretraining? We investigate this question through a case study on entity comparison, e.g., Between France and Brazil, which country is larger?, across nine comparison tasks spanning five entity types. We begin with controlled experiments in which we train small LMs (163M parameters) on mixtures of natural text from pretraining corpora and synthetic task data. Our analysis identifies three distinct phases of learning: (1) an early phase where the LM selects entities by frequency, (2) a middle phase where the LM selects entities by position in the prompt (first vs. last mentioned entity), and (3) a late phase where the LM selects the entity that is the correct answer. We show that the emergence of these three phases is causally determined by statistical properties of the training data. With small amounts of task-specific synthetic data, we observe only the first two phases and the model fails to learn the task; with large amounts, the model jumps directly from the frequency-based heuristic to solving the task correctly. Moreover, changing the entity frequency distribution from a naturally occurring Zipfian distribution (a small number of entities are very common and the vast majority are rare) to a uniform one weakens the frequency phase and speeds up learning of the task. Lastly, we show that the three phases of training dynamics from our controlled experiments appear in the open source model OLMo-2 32B. Together, our findings demonstrate that properties of pretraining data are causal drivers of heuristic learning and show that small-scale synthetic experiments can predict training dynamics at larger scales.
items.abstract_zh: 数据在预训练全程如何塑造语言模型（LM）行为？我们通过对实体比较的案例研究来考察这一问题，例如“法国和巴西之间，哪个国家更大？”，涵盖跨越五类实体类型的九个比较任务。我们首先进行受控实验，在来自预训练语料的自然文本与合成任务数据的混合上训练小型LM（163M参数）。我们的分析识别出三个不同的学习阶段：（1）早期阶段，LM按频率选择实体；（2）中期阶段，LM按提示中的位置（最先提及与最后提及的实体）选择实体；（3）晚期阶段，LM选择作为正确答案的实体。我们表明，这三个阶段的出现由训练数据的统计特性因果决定。在少量任务特定合成数据下，我们仅观察到前两个阶段，模型未能学会该任务；在大量此类数据下，模型从基于频率的启发式直接跳到正确解决任务。此外，将实体频率分布从自然出现的Zipf分布（少数实体非常常见，绝大多数罕见）改为均匀分布，会削弱频率阶段并加快任务学习。最后，我们表明，受控实验中的三个训练动态阶段出现在开源模型 OLMo-2 32B 中。总之，我们的发现表明预训练数据的属性是启发式学习的因果驱动因素，并表明小规模合成实验可以预测更大规模下的训练动态。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: ESI: An Embodied Self-Improvement Flywheel for LLM-VLA Agents
items.title_zh: ESI：面向LLM-VLA智能体的具身自我改进飞轮
items.abstract_en: Independently pretrained language models and vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide complementary building blocks for embodied agents, but connecting them does not automatically produce coordinated behavior. The VLA may generate actions that diverge from the LLM's intended subtask and, upon regaining control after a correction, undo the promising state restored by the LLM. We introduce ESI (Embodied Self-Improvement), an automated flywheel that uses environmental interaction to align reasoning and action. ESI treats the modular agent as the unit of post-training, repeatedly refining the prompts that guide the LLM, the shared skill interface that expresses its intent, and the VLA parameters that realize that intent, then redeploying these components together. Our key insight is that collaboration itself can supply supervision for improving this interface. The LLM's subtask decisions provide semantic supervision for what the policy should execute, while its effective corrections and subsequent student continuations provide action-level supervision for recovery and handoff. The student also learns from its own effective execution, allowing locally useful experience to contribute even when the overall episode fails. On ten selected RoboDojo tasks, ESI achieves a mean Score of 62.03 and a mean success rate of 49.41% using an LLM-VLA agent without generating task-specific control code. On both metrics, it outperforms the published reference results of all hybrid embodied agents, including the Agent+WAM system GO-3 Nano Preview (47.27 Score and 36.60% success), as well as all compared code-based methods.
items.abstract_zh: 独立预训练的语言模型和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略为具身智能体提供了互补的构建模块，但将它们连接起来并不会自动产生协调行为。VLA可能生成偏离LLM预期子任务的动作，并且在一次纠正后重新获得控制时，可能撤销LLM恢复的有希望状态。我们提出ESI（具身自我改进），一种利用环境交互使推理与动作对齐的自动飞轮。ESI将模块化智能体作为后训练单元，反复改进引导LLM的提示、表达其意图的共享技能接口以及实现该意图的VLA参数，然后共同重新部署这些组件。我们的关键见解是，协作本身可以为改进该接口提供监督。LLM的子任务决策为策略应执行什么提供语义监督，而其有效纠正及后续学生延续为恢复和交接提供动作级监督。学生也从自身有效执行中学习，使局部有用的经验即使在整体回合失败时也能作出贡献。在十个选定的RoboDojo任务上，ESI使用LLM-VLA智能体在无需生成任务特定控制代码的情况下取得平均Score 62.03和平均成功率49.41%。在这两项指标上，它优于所有混合具身智能体已发表的参考结果，包括Agent+WAM系统GO-3 Nano Preview（47.27 Score和36.60%成功率），以及所有比较的基于代码的方法。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: ThermalSplat: Generalizable Pose-Free Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Thermal 3D Reconstruction
items.title_zh: ThermalSplat：面向稀疏视角热红外三维重建的可泛化无位姿高斯泼溅
items.abstract_en: Thermal infrared imaging is vital for applications like search-and-rescue and autonomous navigation, yet trans- lating it into 3D scene representations remains a critical bottleneck. The low-texture nature and view-dependent emissivity of thermal images cause standard pose estima- tors to fail catastrophically, collapsing standard 3D Gaus- sian Splatting pipelines under sparse-view constraints. Fur- thermore, existing thermal reconstruction methods rely heavily on dense capture and computationally expensive per-scene optimization. Critically, many of these ap- proaches depend on aligned RGB-thermal datasets to ob- tain reliable camera poses and initial point clouds, ren- dering them unusable in purely thermal, unposed envi- ronments. To break this bottleneck, we present Thermal- Splat, the first generalizable, feed-forward Gaussian splat- ting framework that reconstructs 3D scenes directly from sparse thermal images without requiring known camera poses, RGB guidance, or per-scene training. We over- come thermal-specific challenges using a soft census loss for brightness-invariant structural matching and a bound- ary structure loss to explicitly supervise temperature discon- tinuities. Trained on an aggregated multi-source dataset, ThermalSplat synthesizes sharp reconstructions of unseen scenes in a single feed-forward pass. Extensive experi- ments demonstrate that ThermalSplat holds a strict advan- tage over scene-specific thermal splatting methods in the sparse regime. Furthermore, even compared against these baselines operating under their ideal dense capture set- tings, ThermalSplat achieves superior perceptual fidelity. By eliminating the need for computationally expensive per scene optimization, ThermalSplat offers an efficient and generalizable approach to thermal 3D reconstruction.
items.abstract_zh: 热红外成像对于搜救和自主导航等应用至关重要，但将其转化为三维场景表示仍是一个关键瓶颈。热图像的低纹理特性和视角依赖的发射率会使标准位姿估计器灾难性失效，并在稀疏视角约束下使标准三维高斯泼溅流程崩溃。此外，现有热红外重建方法严重依赖密集采集和计算昂贵的逐场景优化。关键的是，其中许多方法依赖对齐的RGB-热红外数据集来获得可靠相机位姿和初始点云，使其在纯热红外、无位姿环境中无法使用。为打破这一瓶颈，我们提出ThermalSplat，这是首个可直接从稀疏热红外图像重建三维场景的可泛化前馈高斯泼溅框架，无需已知相机位姿、RGB引导或逐场景训练。我们通过用于亮度不变结构匹配的软Census损失和用于显式监督温度不连续的边界结构损失，克服了热红外特有的挑战。在聚合多源数据集上训练后，ThermalSplat可在单次前馈过程中合成未见场景的清晰重建。大量实验表明，在稀疏条件下，ThermalSplat相对于场景特定热红外泼溅方法具有严格优势。此外，即使与在理想密集采集设置下运行的这些基线相比，ThermalSplat也实现了更优的感知保真度。通过消除计算昂贵的逐场景优化需求，ThermalSplat为热红外三维重建提供了一种高效且可泛化的方法。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Listening to the room: disrupting activity of dorsolateral prefrontal cortex impairs learning of room acoustics in human listeners
items.title_zh: 聆听房间：干扰背外侧前额叶皮层活动会损害人类听者对房间声学的学习
items.abstract_en: Navigating complex sensory environments is critical to survival, and brain mechanisms have evolved to cope with the wide range of surroundings we encounter. To determine how listeners learn the statistical properties of acoustic spaces, we assessed their ability to perceive speech in a range of noisy and reverberant rooms. Listeners were also exposed to repetitive transcranial stimulation (rTMS) to disrupt the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) activity, a region believed to play a role in statistical learning. Our data suggest listeners rapidly adapt to statistical characteristics of an environment to improve speech understanding. This ability is impaired when rTMS is applied bilaterally to the dlPFC. The data demonstrate that speech understanding in noise is best when exposed to a room with reverberant characteristics common to human-built environments, with performance declining for higher and lower reverberation times, including fully anechoic (non-reverberant) environments. Our findings provide evidence for a reverberation-sweet-spot and the presence of brain mechanisms that might have evolved to cope with the acoustic characteristics of listening environments encountered every day.
items.abstract_zh: 在复杂感官环境中导航对生存至关重要，大脑机制已进化出应对我们所遇到的各种环境的能力。为确定听者如何学习声学空间的统计特性，我们评估了其在一系列嘈杂和混响房间中感知语音的能力。听者还接受重复经颅刺激（rTMS）以干扰背外侧前额叶皮层（dlPFC）活动，该区域被认为在统计学习中发挥作用。我们的数据表明，听者会快速适应环境的统计特征以改善语音理解。当双侧dlPFC接受rTMS时，这种能力受损。数据表明，当暴露于具有人类建筑环境常见混响特征的房间时，噪声中的语音理解最佳；对于更高和更低的混响时间，包括全消声（无混响）环境，表现下降。我们的发现为混响最佳点以及可能存在已进化出应对日常聆听环境声学特征的大脑机制提供了证据。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Asymmetric Frequency Conversion and Violation of Kirchhoff's Law of Thermal Radiation in Phased Floquet Metasurfaces
items.title_zh: 相位化 Floquet 超表面中的非对称频率转换与热辐射基尔霍夫定律的违背
items.abstract_en: We study a system of three closely spaced conducting sheets, whose thermal emission largely violates Kirchhoff's law through nonreciprocal frequency conversion enabled by Floquet phenomena. We leverage surface mode transitions controlled by temporal modulation of one of the metasurfaces, resulting in largely asymmetric frequency conversion. Our findings broaden the capabilities of Floquet metasurfaces for wave conversion and energy manipulation, paving the way towards magnet-free nonreciprocal photonic devices with opportunities for thermal management and efficient photonic refrigeration.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究由三片紧密排列的导电薄片构成的体系，借助 Floquet 现象实现的非互易频率转换，使其热辐射大幅违背基尔霍夫定律。我们通过对其中一层超表面施加时间调制来控制表面模式的转变，从而获得高度非对称的频率转换。该发现拓展了 Floquet 超表面在波转换与能量操控方面的能力，为无需磁场的非互易光子器件开辟了道路，并在热管理与高效光子制冷方面具有潜在应用。
items.highlight_zh: 时间调制超表面实现非互易频率转换，使热辐射违背基尔霍夫定律
items.digest_zh:
研究了什么问题：按基尔霍夫定律，物体在给定频率和方向上的发射率应等于其吸收率，热辐射因此受到严格约束。要打破这一约束必须引入非互易性，而传统做法依赖外加磁场，器件笨重、难以集成。

用了什么方法：作者构建了一个由三片间距很近的导电薄片组成的超表面体系，并对其中一层进行周期性的时间调制。这种调制产生 Floquet 边带，使入射波在反射/发射过程中发生频率转换；通过调节调制相位，可以控制表面模式的转变，从而把能量非对称地导向不同频率。

有什么结果：频率转换呈现高度非对称性——向上和向下转换的效率差别悬殊，体系因此不再满足发射率与吸收率相等的平衡关系，热辐射显著违背基尔霍夫定律。

为何重要：这是无需磁铁的非互易光子方案，把 Floquet 超表面的能力从单纯的波前调控扩展到频率与能量的定向操控。对未来热管理、辐射制冷/光子制冷以及集成非互易光子器件都有启发意义。讲清

需要注意的边界，作者给出的是理论与数值层面的机制演示，实际器件的调制速率与损耗仍是工程化的关键挑战。

items.title_en: PF-Exec: Large-Scale UAV Relay Load Balancing with an Anchored Potential Direction Decider and a Per-Dimension Gain-Learning Executor
items.title_zh: PF-Exec：基于锚定势方向决策器与逐维增益学习执行器的大规模无人机中继负载均衡
items.abstract_en: Relay load balancing in large-scale UAV networks requires joint decisions on association, bandwidth, power and hovering position, while the dimension grows with the number of UAVs and each UAV sees only its local state. This paper splits the decision into two layers. An anchored potential direction decider emits a closed-form target at every instant and returns its direction only. A gain-learning executor maps a local observation into a positive gain per dimension, composes gain and target, and clips the action against the physical single-step bound; the two layers form PF-Exec. The unit gain is the default start, so the executor reduces to the pure potential policy before training. The load is first-order homogeneous in bandwidth, making the bandwidth target closed form, and the position target is the demand-weighted centroid of the served users. The system uses a two-hop access and millimetre-wave backhaul link with soft association, a 3GPP UMa-AV channel with two shadowing layers, an OU-type social-force crowd and a quadrotor physical layer. Evaluation spans all fleet sizes, two crowd scenarios, independent seeds, the published baselines in their own settings and a degraded-information line. In the highest-pressure burst setting the fixed-step comparison breaks down on part of the seeds, losing fairness and mean load at once, while PF-Exec holds fairness near one. Among the ten comparison methods only the greedy heuristic survives that setting; its load variance stays far higher. Under stale global state and position noise the fairness index stays high at both largest-scale scenarios. Flight energy is nearly identical between the learned and the fixed-step executor, and three constants are fixed once across all settings. The convergence properties of both layers, from the truncated gain iteration to the perturbed tracking bound, are proved in the companion analysis.
items.abstract_zh: 大规模无人机网络中的中继负载均衡需要就关联、带宽、功率和悬停位置进行联合决策，而维度随无人机数量增长，且每架无人机仅能看到其局部状态。本文将决策分为两层。锚定势方向决策器在每个时刻输出闭式目标，并且只返回其方向。增益学习执行器将局部观测映射为每个维度的正增益，组合增益与目标，并依据物理单步边界对动作进行裁剪；两层构成PF-Exec。单位增益是默认起点，因此训练前执行器退化为纯势策略。负载关于带宽是一阶齐次的，使带宽目标为闭式，位置目标是所服务用户的需求加权质心。系统采用具有软关联的两跳接入与毫米波回传链路、包含两层阴影的3GPP UMa-AV信道、OU型社会力人群以及四旋翼物理层。评估覆盖所有机队规模、两种人群场景、独立随机种子、各自设置下的已发表基线以及一条信息退化条件线。在最高压力突发设置中，固定步长对比在部分种子上失效，同时损失公平性和平均负载，而PF-Exec将公平性保持在接近1。在十种对比方法中，只有贪心启发式在该设置下仍有效；其负载方差仍高得多。在过时全局状态和位置噪声下，两个最大规模场景中的公平性指数仍保持较高。学习型执行器与固定步长执行器的飞行能耗几乎相同，并且三个常数在所有设置中一次性固定。两层从截断增益迭代到扰动跟踪界的收敛性质在配套分析中证明。

items.title_en: Learning Word-Level Explanations of Text Reuse in Latin Literature with Little Annotation
items.title_zh: 少标注学习拉丁文学文本复用中的词级解释
items.abstract_en: Detecting an intertextual reference is only the first step; philologists also need to know how a later author reworked the source. We explain a reuse pair word by word: each word of the reusing passage is first aligned to its source word, then labeled with the operation that transformed it, such as a copy, a change of inflection, or a substitution. Such word-level operations are expensive to annotate, and only a few corpora annotated at this level exist for text reuse in Latin literature. We describe a procedure that needs only a limited number of annotations: synthetic pairs, built by applying known operations to Latin text, train a first model, and active learning chooses the pairs an annotator corrects. Among several architectures, a model that links and labels together performs best: a pointer network that, for every reuse word, chooses a source word and names the operation in the same step. We show that with active learning, 200 pairs chosen by uncertainty are enough for the model to match one trained on every annotated pair of the 1,490 references of the Loci Similes benchmark. We release our code, word-level predictions for all references, and an interactive demo.
items.abstract_zh: 检测到互文引用只是第一步；语文学家还需要知道后来的作者如何改写来源。我们逐词解释一个复用对：复用段落中的每个词先与其来源词对齐，然后标注改变它的操作，例如复制、屈折变化或替换。此类词级操作标注成本高，拉丁文学文本复用中仅有少量在此层级标注的语料。我们描述一种仅需有限标注的流程：通过对拉丁文本应用已知操作构建合成对来训练初始模型，并由主动学习选择标注者要纠正的对。在若干架构中，将链接与标注结合在一起的模型表现最佳：一个指针网络，对每个复用词在同一步骤中选择来源词并命名操作。我们表明，借助主动学习，按不确定性选出的200对足以使模型匹配在Loci Similes基准全部1,490条引用的每个标注对上训练的模型。我们发布代码、所有引用的词级预测以及交互式演示。

items.title_en: CT-SGAL-LIO: Causal Continuous Time Refinement of Discrete LiDAR Inertial Odometry
items.title_zh: CT-SGAL-LIO：离散LiDAR惯性里程计的因果连续时间细化
items.abstract_en: State-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial odometry methods, including those on richer state manifolds, achieve strong global accuracy, yet their pose stream alternates between propagation and correction and can oscillate over short horizons even when globally accurate. Most existing methods follow these approaches: they either modify the filter to enable faster updates or estimate a continuous-time trajectory from raw LiDAR and inertial data. The latter involves extra optimization, delaying state updates and becoming less robust during rapid rotations or accelerations. We propose CT-SGAL-LIO, a continuous-time refinement module that smooths the posterior pose stream of a discrete SGal(3) estimator without modifying the estimator itself. The key novelty is to perform continuous-time trajectory refinement directly on the projected SGal(3) posterior: we fit a cubic trajectory over a bounded window of recent poses and evaluate it at a small fixed lag. This places the query time within the observed interval, so the refined pose is obtained by interpolation rather than extrapolation, while preserving causal operation. CT-SGAL-LIO improves relative trajectory accuracy on 17 sequences from three public benchmarks. Across 17 sequences from GRAND-TOUR, MCD, and GEODE, CT-SGAL-LIO improves short-term motion accuracy while largely preserving global accuracy. RTE improves by up to 70% on GRAND-TOUR and on all seven GEODE sequences, with 9.9-51.1% reductions. A 19.5-min R-Campus run also reduces posterior jumps by 85.4% with only a 4.7 mm change in the end-to-start gap. We plan to release our source code and results to support community validation and reproducibility.
items.abstract_zh: 最先进的LiDAR-惯性里程计方法，包括那些在更丰富状态流形上的方法，实现了很强的全局精度，但其位姿流在传播和校正之间交替，并且即使全局准确，也可能在短时间范围内振荡。大多数现有方法遵循这些途径：要么修改滤波器以实现更快更新，要么从原始LiDAR和惯性数据估计连续时间轨迹。后者涉及额外优化，延迟状态更新，并在快速旋转或加速时变得不那么稳健。我们提出CT-SGAL-LIO，一个连续时间细化模块，可在不修改估计器本身的情况下平滑离散SGal(3)估计器的后验位姿流。关键创新是直接在投影后的SGal(3)后验上执行连续时间轨迹细化：我们在最近位姿的有界窗口上拟合三次轨迹，并在小的固定滞后处对其进行求值。这将查询时间置于观测区间内，因此细化后的位姿通过插值而非外推获得，同时保持因果操作。CT-SGAL-LIO提高了来自三个公开基准的17个序列上的相对轨迹精度。在来自GRAND-TOUR、MCD和GEODE的17个序列上，CT-SGAL-LIO提高了短期运动精度，同时基本保持全局精度。RTE在GRAND-TOUR和全部七个GEODE序列上最高提升70%，降幅为9.9–51.1%。一次19.5分钟的R-Campus运行还将后验跳变减少了85.4%，而终点到起点间隙仅变化4.7 mm。我们计划发布源代码和结果，以支持社区验证和可复现性。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为神经辐射场用于视图合成
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入为单个连续5D坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出为该空间位置处的体积密度和与视角相关的发射辐射。我们通过沿相机光线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Warming, thermal variability, and the 96% decline in childhood respiratory-infection mortality in China: a national time-series analysis of the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021 and the C-LSAT high-resolution climate dataset
items.title_zh: 变暖、温度变率与中国儿童呼吸道感染死亡率下降 96%：基于全球疾病负担研究 2021 与 C-LSAT 高分辨率气候数据集的全国时间序列分析
items.abstract_en: Background Childhood respiratory mortality in China has fallen by over 90% in three decades alongside sustained national warming, yet national long-run evidence on temperature and child respiratory mortality is lacking. Methods We linked Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2021 mortality estimates (rates use a fixed 2022 population denominator, so rate trends equal death-count trends) for China - lower respiratory infections (LRI), ages 0-19, and asthma, ages 0-24, 1990-2021 - with C-LSAT 0.5 degree gridded temperature data (1990-2019), aggregated nationally and to five climate zones. Four annual indicators (mean temperature, diurnal temperature range, seasonal amplitude, interannual variability) entered regressions of log mortality rates with Newey-West standard errors. A bootstrapped (500 resamples) quadratic model probed the minimum mortality temperature (MMT), with PM2.5-adjusted analyses and future-exposure, permutation, and detrended falsification tests. Changes in China's national thermal regime for 2041-2060 were additionally projected under three CMIP6 SSP scenarios (SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5; WorldClim v2.1 1970-2000 baseline, MRI-ESM2-0) using a matched-cell delta method. Results LRI deaths fell by 96.3% (330,194 in 1990 to 12,098 in 2021; 95% uncertainty interval 9,669-14,891) and asthma deaths by 94.9% (3,287 to 167), while mean temperature rose 0.364 degrees C per decade and diurnal temperature range narrowed 0.092 degrees C per decade. Baseline coefficients were large (mean temperature -1.696, SE 0.174; diurnal temperature range +2.408, SE 0.336; seasonal amplitude -0.162, SE 0.082; interannual variability +2.924, SE 1.514, per 1 degree C in log rate), but the future-exposure test failed and detrending nullified every coefficient: the associations are trend-level, and short-cycle causal effects are not identifiable. Nor was the national MMT identifiable - observed temperature support spans only 6.66-8.13 degrees C, and the nominal turning point of 35.84 degrees C is an extrapolation artifact (quadratic term p = 0.963). Within the observed range, warming and declining mortality moved in the same direction. A CMIP6 scenario projection (WorldClim v2.1, MRI-ESM2-0, matched-cell national means) indicates a further +2.19 to +3.02 degrees C of national warming by 2041-2060, with little change in diurnal temperature range or seasonal amplitude. Conclusions The 96% decline in childhood respiratory mortality cannot be attributed to warming. China sits on the low-temperature side of the optimum, and the marginal direction of future warming requires stronger designs to establish. The falsification framework offers a discipline for climate-health inference in China. Bias-corrected scenario projections place China's 2050s mean temperature (approximately 9.4-10.3 degrees C on the C-LSAT scale) still far below multi-country optima (14.7-19.8 degrees C), noting that an annual-mean construct is not fully comparable with daily-scale MMT estimates.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：三十年间，中国儿童呼吸道死亡率下降超过 90%，同期全国持续变暖，但仍缺乏关于温度与儿童呼吸道死亡率的全国长期证据。方法：我们将全球疾病负担（GBD）2021 的死亡率估计值（率采用固定的 2022 年人口分母，因此率的趋势与死亡数趋势相同）——中国 0–19 岁下呼吸道感染（LRI）和 0–24 岁哮喘，1990–2021 年——与 C-LSAT 0.5 度网格温度数据（1990–2019）相链接，汇总至全国及五个气候区。四个年度指标（平均温度、昼夜温差、季节振幅、年际变率）进入以对数死亡率为因变量的回归，采用 Newey-West 标准误。一个自助法（500 次重抽样）二次模型探究最低死亡温度（MMT），并开展 PM2.5 调整分析以及未来暴露、置换和去趋势证伪检验。此外，采用匹配格点 delta 方法，在三种 CMIP6 SSP 情景（SSP1-2.6、SSP2-4.5 和 SSP5-8.5；WorldClim v2.1 1970–2000 基线，MRI-ESM2-0）下预测中国 2041–2060 年全国热力状况的变化。结果：LRI 死亡下降 96.3%（1990 年 330,194 例降至 2021 年 12,098 例；95% 不确定区间 9,669–14,891），哮喘死亡下降 94.9%（3,287 降至 167），而平均温度每十年上升 0.364 摄氏度，昼夜温差每十年收窄 0.092 摄氏度。基线系数很大（平均温度 −1.696，SE 0.174；昼夜温差 +2.408，SE 0.336；季节振幅 −0.162，SE 0.082；年际变率 +2.924，SE 1.514，均为每 1 摄氏度对应的对数率变化），但未来暴露检验未通过，去趋势使所有系数归零：这些关联处于趋势层面，短周期因果效应无法识别。全国 MMT 也无法识别——观测到的温度支撑范围仅为 6.66–8.13 摄氏度，而 35.84 摄氏度的名义转折点是外推假象（二次项 p = 0.963）。在观测范围内，变暖与死亡率下降方向相同。一项 CMIP6 情景预测（WorldClim v2.1、MRI-ESM2-0、匹配格点全国均值）表明，到 2041–2060 年全国将再升温 +2.19 至 +3.02 摄氏度，昼夜温差或季节振幅变化很小。结论：儿童呼吸道死亡率下降 96% 不能归因于变暖。中国位于最适温度的低温度一侧，未来变暖的边际方向需要更强的设计才能确定。该证伪框架为中国气候—健康推断提供了一种规范。偏差校正的情景预测显示，中国 2050 年代平均温度（按 C-LSAT 尺度约为 9.4–10.3 摄氏度）仍远低于多国最适温度（14.7–19.8 摄氏度），并指出年均值构念与日尺度 MMT 估计并不完全可比。

items.title_en: Metasurfaces with Anisotropic Electric and Magnetic Conductivities: Parameter Retrieval for Arbitrary Incidence and Polarization
items.title_zh: 具有各向异性电导率与磁导率的超表面：面向任意入射与极化的参数反演
items.abstract_en: Metasurfaces come in a great variety of unit cell geometries and material composition. A common approach for describing them relies on retrieving effective surface parameters (e.g., electric and magnetic conductivities) from plane-wave scattering data. Conventional retrieval methods are often limited to isotropic unit cells, a uniform host material, or lead to increased complexity by requiring reflection and transmission coefficients from both sides of the metasurface. Here, we derive analytical expressions for the equivalent surface conductivities of an electrically- and magnetically-polarizable anisotropic metasurface under oblique plane-wave incidence with arbitrary polarization. The proposed formulation does not require bidirectional scattering information, thus simplifying the process especially in experimental studies. The method is validated through representative electric and magnetic meta-atoms at microwave and THz frequencies, respectively. Their ability for polarization conversion is demonstrated and discussed relying on the physical insight provided by the retrieved anisotropic conductivities. In addition, we present the inverse expressions for calculating the reflection and transmission coefficients from known surface conductivity tensors, which can prove useful for metasurface synthesis and radiation problems.
items.abstract_zh: 超表面具有种类繁多的单元胞几何结构与材料组成。描述它们的一种常见方法依赖于从平面波散射数据中反演有效表面参数（例如电导率与磁导率）。传统反演方法往往局限于各向同性单元胞、均匀主介质，或需要超表面两侧的反射与透射系数而增加复杂度。本文推导了在斜入射平面波、任意极化条件下，电与磁可极化的各向异性超表面的等效表面电导率的解析表达式。所提公式不需要双向散射信息，因而简化了流程，尤其在实验研究中。该方法分别通过微波与太赫兹频率下具有代表性的电、磁超原子进行了验证。基于反演所得各向异性电导率提供的物理洞见，展示并讨论了它们的极化转换能力。此外，我们给出了由已知表面电导率张量计算反射与透射系数的逆表达式，这对超表面综合与辐射问题可能有用。

items.title_en: Using an energy pixels approach to estimate the size a 2nd Generation DEL must be to train a high-resolution binding model
items.title_zh: 用能量像素方法估计：训练高分辨率结合模型所需的第二代 DEL 规模
items.abstract_en: DNA-encoded libraries (DELs) are commonly used to find small-molecule binders to a target protein. But the hard part is no longer finding a hit. It is building a machine-learning model good enough to guide the medicinal chemistry that follows, one that can resolve the shift in affinity when a chemist changes a single atom. Such a model needs two things from its training data: dense sampling of the small patch of chemical space around the hit, and an adequate number of genuinely tight binders within it. A diverse naive DEL gives neither. It samples an enormous space, so any one neighborhood is covered far too thinly, and the tightest binders are rare. A model trained on that naive DEL data must extrapolate to binders tighter than any it has seen, and that is where models can fail. One way to get training data with both properties is a second-generation DEL built around the hit. We ask how complex that library must be. We treat binding as a sum of small, independent interactions, called pixels on the target and antipixels on the ligand. From the spread of affinities measured in the naive library, with no structural information and nothing yet synthesized, we estimate the complexity such a library must have to supply that dense sampling and those tight binders. The method does two useful things. It turns the number of tight binders a model needs into the number of compounds a library must contain. And it estimates the expected yield of a randomly designed second-generation DEL, so the gain from designing the library with machine learning or active learning can be measured against a baseline, without the expense of a control library as large as the experiment itself.
items.abstract_zh: DNA 编码库（DEL）常用于寻找靶蛋白的小分子结合物，但难点已不再是找到 hit，而是训练出足以指导后续药物化学的机器学习模型——要能分辨化学家改动单个原子所带来的亲和力变化。这类模型对训练数据有两点要求：命中点附近化学空间的密集采样，以及其中数量充足的真正高亲和力结合物。多样化朴素 DEL 两者皆缺：采样空间极大导致每个邻域过于稀疏，强结合物也罕见，模型必须外推到比所见更强的结合物，而这正是模型容易失败之处。围绕 hit 构建第二代 DEL 是获得此类数据的一条途径，我们追问该库需要多复杂。我们把结合视为目标上的“像素”与配体上的“反像素”之间独立小作用之和；仅依据朴素库中测得的亲和力分布（无需结构信息、尚未合成任何化合物），即可估计该库为提供密集采样与强结合物所需的复杂度。该方法的用处在于：把模型所需强结合物数量换算为库应含的化合物数量，并估计随机设计二代 DEL 的期望产出，从而为机器学习或主动学习设计库的增益提供基线，无需合成与实验同等规模的对照库。
items.highlight_zh: 不合成化合物，即可预估二代 DEL 所需规模与产出
items.digest_zh:
1）研究问题：用 DNA 编码库（DEL）筛选小分子早已能出 hit，真正卡脖子的是后续模型：要指导药物化学微调，模型必须能分辨“改一个原子”造成的亲和力变化，也就是高分辨率。这种模型对训练数据要求苛刻——命中点周围的化学空间要密采样，且里面要有足够多真正结合得紧的分子。而普通的“朴素”DEL 两头都不满足：空间太大导致邻域极稀疏，强结合物又很少，模型等于被迫外推到它从没见过的高亲和力区域，容易失准。
2）方法：思路是围绕 hit 专门设计第二代 DEL。作者把结合能建模为一系列小的、相互独立的相互作用之和，形象地称为靶标上的“像素”与配体上的“反像素”。只利用朴素库里测到的亲和力分布，不需要蛋白结构信息，也不需要先合成任何化合物，就能估算出这个二代库要多复杂（多大）才够用。
3）结果与工具价值：方法给出两件实用产出：一是把“模型需要多少个强结合物”换算成“库必须装多少化合物”；二是预估随机设计的二代 DEL 的期望产出，相当于一个基线。有了这个基线，用机器学习或主动学习来设计库究竟带来多少增益就能被量化，而不必付出合成一个与实验同等规模对照库的昂贵代价。
4）为何重要：它把一个耗资巨大的湿实验决策（该建多大的库）前移到几乎零成本的计算估算，为 DEL 驱动的药物发现提供了可规划的资源分配依据。

items.title_en: NER-D: A cross-domain benchmark for German NER
items.title_zh: NER-D：德语NER的跨域基准
items.abstract_en: We present NER-D, a cross-domain benchmark for German NER comprising 13 datasets spanning 9 domains, including General/Politics, Wikipedia, Legal, Medical, Historical, Financial, Agriculture and Archaeology. We examine the performance of both proprietary LLMs and state-of-the-art small open-source models using normal prompting and further examine the performance gains achievable via in-context learning and LoRA fine-tuning. Our results show that without any sort of optimization a proprietary model (GPT-5.4 mini) outperforms the smaller open-source models on 6 out of 13 datasets, but LoRA fine-tuning enables the smaller models to substantially outperform the proprietary baseline. We further analyze the influence of the domain and the tagset used in each task on the performance achieved in the different evaluation settings. Our benchmark will be available as a resource for the development of future German NER methods on both general and specialized domains.\footnote{We make our code, data, and models publicly available upon acceptance of this paper.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出NER-D，一个德语NER跨域基准，包含涵盖9个领域的13个数据集，包括通用/政治、维基百科、法律、医学、历史、金融、农业和考古学。我们考察专有LLM和最先进的小型开源模型在常规提示下的表现，并进一步考察通过上下文学习和LoRA微调可获得的性能提升。结果表明，在没有任何优化的情况下，专有模型（GPT-5.4 mini）在13个数据集中的6个上优于较小开源模型，但LoRA微调使较小模型能够显著优于专有基线。我们进一步分析各任务所用领域和标签集对不同评估设置下所获性能的影响。我们的基准将作为资源，用于开发未来面向通用和专门领域的德语NER方法。录用后我们将公开代码、数据和模型。

items.title_en: What Can a VLA Learn from the Agent That Calls It? Task-Level Experience Distillation for Embodied Navigation
items.title_zh: VLA能从调用它的智能体中学到什么？面向具身导航的任务级经验蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Navigation agents use a large language model (LLM) planner to call a vision-language-action (VLA) model. Each episode needs the LLM, adding cost and delay. We distill successful agent experience into the VLA instead of distilling the planner. The VLA then navigates alone at test time. Agent sessions are not VLA demonstrations. They include motions driven by planner tools and sub-instructions, along with detours. We present H2E, a task-level experience distillation method that converts these sessions into VLA training data. Every motion becomes a VLA action under the original task instruction, with the resulting poses as targets. H2E masks the loss on steps that move away from the goal. It labels every visited state within 1 m of the goal as a stop. We then update the VLA with low-rank adaptation. The VLA learns to stop at the goal and find goals the base model never reaches. On all 3,189 REVERIE-CE val-unseen episodes, H2E raises the success rate of an 8B VLA from 35.0% to 44.9%.
items.abstract_zh: 导航智能体使用大语言模型（LLM）规划器调用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。每个回合都需要LLM，增加了成本和延迟。我们将成功的智能体经验蒸馏到VLA中，而不是蒸馏规划器。于是VLA在测试时单独导航。智能体会话不是VLA演示。它们包括由规划器工具和子指令驱动的运动，以及绕路。我们提出H2E，一种任务级经验蒸馏方法，将这些会话转换为VLA训练数据。每个运动在原始任务指令下成为VLA动作，并以结果位姿作为目标。H2E对远离目标的步骤掩蔽损失。它将目标1米内每个访问过的状态标记为停止。然后我们使用低秩适应更新VLA。VLA学会在目标处停止，并找到基础模型从未到达的目标。在所有3,189个REVERIE-CE val-unseen回合上，H2E将8B VLA的成功率从35.0%提高到44.9%。

items.title_en: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
items.title_zh: Duo：一种用于全双工交互的互惠世界模型
items.abstract_en: In this report, we introduce the Reciprocal World Model (RWM) and present Duo v1, a full-duplex world model that continuously perceives audiovisual inputs while responding to users in real time. The RWM treats intelligence and physical reality as equally fundamental to what constitutes a world. Existing world models largely focus on simulating the latter, leaving reasoning and decision-making as external controls rather than intrinsic parts of the world itself. In RWM, we identify two equally fundamental capabilities: Intent, which provides the cognition underlying world interactions, and Realization, which generates coherent audio-visual behavior. To realize this formulation, Duo v1 introduces three key technical designs: (1) Leveraging autoregressive modeling for continuous interaction reasoning and participation decisions, rather than restricting it to instruction understanding for diffusion models. (2) Constructing chunk-specific conditions and synchronize tokens across Intent and Realization on a unified timeline. Module-specific attention masks enforce causal dependencies both within and across chunks, preventing access to future inputs. (3) Mitigating distribution shift in both modules through dual rollout distillation, training on autoregressively generated Intent tokens and synthesized audiovisual histories from Realization. Both modules continuously perceive real-time audio, video, and text, enabling full-duplex interaction with spontaneous conversations and interruptions. Beyond conversation, users can share real objects, reshape virtual scenes, guide assistants, or play audiovisual games without mouse or keyboard controls. The release of Duo v1 makes our first step, with the next version coming soon. We look forward to broader exploration of this emerging field.
items.abstract_zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍互惠世界模型（RWM），并提出Duo v1——一个在实时回应用户的同时持续感知视听输入的全双工世界模型。RWM将智能与物理现实视为构成世界的同等基本要素。现有世界模型主要侧重于模拟后者，将推理和决策留作外部控制，而非世界本身的内在组成部分。在RWM中，我们确定了两项同等基本的能力：Intent，它提供世界交互背后的认知；Realization，它生成连贯的视听行为。为实现这一表述，Duo v1引入了三项关键技术设计：（1）利用自回归建模进行连续交互推理和参与决策，而不是将其限制为扩散模型的指令理解。（2）构建块特定条件，并在统一时间线上同步Intent与Realization的token。模块特定注意力掩码在块内和块间强制因果依赖，防止访问未来输入。（3）通过双 rollout 蒸馏缓解两个模块中的分布偏移，在自回归生成的Intent token和由Realization合成的视听历史数据上训练。两个模块持续感知实时音频、视频和文本，实现具有自发对话和打断的全双工交互。除对话外，用户还可以共享真实物体、重塑虚拟场景、引导助手或玩视听游戏，无需鼠标或键盘控制。Duo v1的发布迈出了我们的第一步，下一版本即将推出。我们期待对这一新兴领域进行更广泛的探索。

items.title_en: Expert-level localization of fine-grained cardiac structures across the transthoracic echocardiogram
items.title_zh: 经胸超声心动图中心脏细粒度结构的专家级定位
items.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence models for echocardiography interpret studies without identifying the structures that support their outputs. We show that this spatial grounding does not emerge from the pretraining of current vision-language models. General-purpose and medical vision-language models and an open-vocabulary detector recalled 3% or fewer of cardiac structures and scored below a box that never sees the image. EchoLens, a detector trained on 5,912 expert-annotated structures and 4,219 Doppler signals from 136 patients, recalled 87% and localized structures as reliably as a blinded expert reader (box centre within the reference in 95.7% and 95.3% of cases). It covers 21 structures across 11 transthoracic views and 11 spectral Doppler signal types. In external data, two physicians judged 81-92% of its detections correct across all 11 views, and it identified the Doppler signal type in 83% of frames. EchoLens provides the spatial layer that grounded echocardiographic interpretation requires.
items.abstract_zh: 用于超声心动图的AI模型可解读检查，却不识别支撑其输出的结构。我们表明，这种空间定位不会从当前视觉语言模型的预训练中涌现。通用和医学视觉语言模型以及一个开放词汇检测器召回了3%或更少的心脏结构，并且得分低于一个从未看到图像的边界框。EchoLens是一个在来自136名患者的5,912个专家标注结构和4,219个多普勒信号上训练的检测器，召回率为87%，并以与盲法专家读者同样可靠的方式定位结构（在95.7%和95.3%的病例中框中心位于参考范围内）。它覆盖11个经胸视图中的21个结构和11种频谱多普勒信号类型。在外部数据中，两名医生判定其检测结果在所有11个视图中81–92%正确，并且它在83%的帧中识别出多普勒信号类型。EchoLens提供了有依据的超声心动图解读所需的空间层。

items.title_en: Machine-accelerated extraction of experimental superconducting parameters for physical insight and prediction across thousands of materials
items.title_zh: 机器加速提取实验超导参数：面向数千种材料的物理洞察与预测
items.abstract_en: New superconductors could unlock next-generation technologies from nuclear fusion to lossless electronics. Machine learning can predict candidate superconductors but lacks validated experimental training data beyond the critical temperature. Here we present AutoSuperCon, a database of eight superconducting parameters, containing 20354 entries for 6793 superconductors. The data were extracted from over 47000 arXiv preprints using a large language model and validated against reference datasets ($R^2 = 0.96$ with NIMS SuperCon). Using AutoSuperCon, we show that median gap ratios rise from 3.6 in conventional superconductors to 6.4 in cuprates, 28% of upper critical fields exceed the Pauli limit, and critical temperatures lie below a ceiling proportional to the superfluid density. Further, we train composition-based predictors for the critical temperature ($R^2_{\log}=0.83$) and the upper critical field ($R^2_{\log}=0.69$), boosted by transfer learning. Within known superconducting families, composition alone is sufficient to screen candidates for both parameters. AutoSuperCon thus enables physical insight and data-driven discovery across thousands of superconductors.
items.abstract_zh: 新型超导体可能解锁从核聚变到无损电子学的下一代技术。机器学习可以预测候选超导体，但除临界温度外缺乏经过验证的实验训练数据。在此，我们提出AutoSuperCon，一个包含八种超导参数的数据库，收录了6793种超导体的20354条记录。这些数据使用大语言模型从超过47000篇arXiv预印本中提取，并对照参考数据集进行了验证（与NIMS SuperCon的R^2=0.96）。利用AutoSuperCon，我们表明中位能隙比从传统超导体中的3.6上升到铜氧化物中的6.4，28%的上临界场超过泡利极限，且临界温度低于与超流密度成正比的上限。此外，我们训练了基于成分的预测器来预测临界温度（R^2_log=0.83）和上临界场（R^2_log=0.69），并通过迁移学习得到提升。在已知超导家族内，仅凭成分就足以筛选这两个参数的候选材料。因此，AutoSuperCon能够在数千种超导体中实现物理洞察和数据驱动发现。

items.title_en: A Recipe for Physical Action Model Training
items.title_zh: 物理动作模型训练的实施方案
items.abstract_en: Choosing robot model capacity and demonstration budgets also requires decisions about data composition, representation, optimization, and deployment. We connect these decisions through a common conditional-distribution target. Nested learning oracles give exact risk accounting; local information geometry, conditional mutual information, and empirical convergence provide conditional training prescriptions. Known-target numerical checks expose capacity-data coupling, representation-induced mixture mismatch, and an example where deployment KL increases while negative log-likelihood decreases. An analysis of 206 public PushT trajectories evaluates fixed-feature information-design criteria without fitting a policy. Under asymmetric evaluation targets, the selected allocations reduce this criterion by 4.5-6.2% relative to target matching; balanced targets show no benefit. These results clarify which quantities can support training recommendations and when an apparently favorable predictive metric has a different interpretation.
items.abstract_zh: 选择机器人模型容量与示范数据预算，还需要就数据组成、表示、优化与部署做出决策。我们通过一个共同的条件分布目标将这些决策联系起来。嵌套学习预言机给出精确的风险核算；局部信息几何、条件互信息与经验收敛性提供条件化的训练处方。已知目标的数值检验揭示了容量—数据耦合、表示诱发的混合失配，以及一个部署 KL 上升而负对数似然下降的例子。对 206 条公开 PushT 轨迹的分析在不拟合策略的情况下评估固定特征的信息设计准则。在非对称评估目标下，所选分配使该准则相对目标匹配降低 4.5–6.2%；平衡目标则无收益。这些结果厘清了哪些量可支撑训练建议，以及一个看似有利的预测指标何时具有不同的解释。

items.title_en: WebArena-Pro: A Heterogeneous, Multimodal, Reproducible Benchmark for Web Agents
items.title_zh: WebArena-Pro：面向Web智能体的异构、多模态、可复现基准
items.abstract_en: Web agents powered by large language and vision-language models are increasingly applied to realistic browser work that spans heterogeneous applications, multimodal content, and stateful workflows. However, existing reproducible web-agent benchmarks cover only a small number of web applications drawn from a few software categories, and restrict modality to text and vision. Live benchmarks broaden site coverage but sacrifice reproducibility, since pages and data drift between runs. Moreover, existing benchmarks do not meaningfully evaluate whether agents can understand and use audio and video content embedded within web tasks. To address these gaps, we introduce WebArena-Pro, a benchmark comprising 300 tasks across 20 self-hosted web applications in six domain categories, spanning distinct interface conventions, workflows, and data models. Across the evaluated agents, the best performance is achieved by both Codex with GPT 6.1 Sol and Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 at 62.3%, followed by OpenCode with Kimi 3.1 Pro at 60.7%. The strongest GenericAgent configurations, Gemini 3.1 Pro omni and Gemma4 31B, both achieve 30.3%. Among reproducible, human-curated web agent benchmarks, WebArena-Pro provides the broadest application coverage and the most comprehensive multimodal support to date. The benchmark treats audio and video as core observations alongside text and vision, with dedicated actions for extracting information from each. WebArena-Pro runs each task in isolation and supports reproducible, parallel evaluation. Tasks are authored through a dedicated annotator interface, filtered by LLM-assisted triage, and finally validated by humans before release. Project page: https://webarena-pro.github.io
items.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型和视觉-语言模型驱动的Web智能体正越来越多地应用于现实浏览器工作，这些工作跨越异构应用、多模态内容和有状态工作流。然而，现有的可复现Web智能体基准仅覆盖来自少数软件类别的少量Web应用，并将模态限制为文本和视觉。在线基准扩大了站点覆盖范围，但牺牲了可复现性，因为页面和数据在运行之间会漂移。此外，现有基准并未有意义地评估智能体能否理解并使用Web任务中嵌入的音频和视频内容。为弥补这些空白，我们引入WebArena-Pro，一个包含6个领域类别中20个自托管Web应用上300个任务的基准，涵盖不同的接口约定、工作流和数据模型。在受评估的智能体中，最佳性能由Codex with GPT 6.1 Sol和Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5共同取得，均为62.3%，其次是OpenCode with Kimi 3.1 Pro，为60.7%。最强的GenericAgent配置Gemini 3.1 Pro omni和Gemma4 31B均达到30.3%。在可复现、人工策划的Web智能体基准中，WebArena-Pro提供了迄今最广泛的应用覆盖和最全面的多模态支持。该基准将音频和视频与文本和视觉一起视为核心观察，并为从每种模态提取信息设置了专门动作。WebArena-Pro在隔离环境中运行每个任务，并支持可复现的并行评估。任务通过专门的标注者界面编写，经LLM辅助分诊过滤，并在发布前由人工最终验证。项目页面：https://webarena-pro.github.io

items.title_en: Reading the Table: Sim-to-Real Game State Detection for the Chef's Hat Card Game
items.title_zh: 读懂桌面：Chef's Hat 卡牌游戏的仿真到真实游戏状态检测
items.abstract_en: Tabletop games offer a compelling scenario to study the interaction between artificial and human agents, combining social interaction with game state tracking and physical manipulation. To assess the game state, a robot needs to precisely detect closely related game objects, such as different card designs, requiring dedicated training data that is costly to annotate in the real world. Instead, we develop a fully automated synthetic data collection pipeline, using re-projection of known 3D coordinates to generate labels automatically and domain randomization to bridge the reality gap. This approach is used to collect a dataset of 25413 samples to finetune an object detection and a segmentation model, which are combined to assign detected cards to game-relevant zones and infer the game state. When evaluated on a real NICO humanoid robot, our pipeline achieves an F1-score of 0.906 for card-to-zone assignment, thus providing the perceptual foundation for a robot that can autonomously play Chef's Hat against human players.
items.abstract_zh: 桌面游戏提供了一个有吸引力的场景，用于研究人工代理与人类代理之间的交互，将社交互动与游戏状态跟踪和物理操作相结合。为评估游戏状态，机器人需要精确检测密切相关的游戏对象，例如不同卡牌设计，这需要专门的训练数据，而在真实世界中标注这些数据成本高昂。相反，我们开发了一个全自动合成数据收集流程，利用已知3D坐标的重投影自动生成标签，并使用域随机化弥合现实差距。该方法用于收集包含25413个样本的数据集，以微调目标检测和分割模型，并将二者结合，将检测到的卡牌分配到游戏相关区域并推断游戏状态。在真实NICO人形机器人上评估时，我们的流程在卡牌到区域分配上达到0.906的F1分数，从而为能够自主与人类玩家玩Chef's Hat的机器人提供感知基础。

items.title_en: VLAN: Vision-Language Accessible Navigation
items.title_zh: VLAN：视觉-语言无障碍导航
items.abstract_en: Accessible mobility is user-conditioned rather than scene-intrinsic, as walkable paths for one embodiment are inaccessible to another. Yet, existing benchmarks evaluate traversability under a fixed and limited embodiment. We present Vision-Language Accessible Navigation (VLAN), containing 1,000 scenes, 20K navigation trajectories, and 160K keyframes across diverse lighting, environmental conditions, scene semantics, and path geometries. For each trajectory, VLAN provides embodiment-specific actions and accessibility features for legged and wheeled agents, including humanoid and quadruped robots and people with visual or mobility impairments, while everyday obstacles and accessibility labels are categorized as Passable, Bypass, HighRisk, and Blocked. Unlike goal-only evaluation, our benchmark measures physical safety and alignment with user-specific constraints via goal-reaching, collision-aware, and accessibility-aligned metrics. We benchmark modern vision-language models and find they often fail to consistently adapt obstacle relevance, path selection, and safety criteria across user profiles, suggesting accessibility-aware navigation requires dedicated datasets, tasks, and metrics beyond conventional embodied navigation evaluation. All data and code open-source at https://github.com/InSAI-Lab/VLAN.
items.abstract_zh: 无障碍移动性取决于用户条件，而非场景固有属性，因为对一种具身形态可行的路径对另一种具身形态可能不可访问。然而，现有基准在固定且有限的具身形态下评估可通行性。我们提出视觉-语言无障碍导航（VLAN），包含1,000个场景、20K条导航轨迹和160K个关键帧，覆盖多样光照、环境条件、场景语义和路径几何。对于每条轨迹，VLAN为腿式和轮式智能体提供具身特定的动作和无障碍特征，包括人形机器人和四足机器人以及有视觉或行动障碍的人，同时日常障碍物和无障碍标签被分为Passable、Bypass、HighRisk和Blocked。与仅评估目标不同，我们的基准通过目标到达、碰撞感知和无障碍对齐指标来衡量物理安全性和与用户特定约束的一致性。我们对现代视觉-语言模型进行基准测试，发现它们往往无法在不同用户画像之间一致地调整障碍物相关性、路径选择和安全标准，这表明无障碍感知导航需要超越传统具身导航评估的专门数据集、任务和指标。所有数据和代码开源在https://github.com/InSAI-Lab/VLAN。

items.title_en: After the vaccine era: sequencing platform investments as the childhood pneumonia spectrum diversifies
items.title_zh: 疫苗时代之后：儿童肺炎病原谱多样化背景下的测序平台投资
items.abstract_en: Background The historic decline in childhood pneumonia mortality was driven substantially by single-pathogen vaccines against Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib) and Streptococcus pneumoniae. Yet the pathogen spectrum underlying child pneumonia deaths is diversifying: the effective number of pathogens rose from 5.57 in 1990 to 9.94 in 2023, and the residual burden is shifting toward opportunistic and hospital-associated pathogens for which no licensed childhood vaccines exist. This paper asks how resources should be sequenced between single-pathogen interventions and platform investments as this transition proceeds. Methods We analyzed Global Burden of Disease Study 2023 deaths from 29 pathogens in ages 0-19 years by super-region, combined with WHO/UNICEF Estimates of National Immunization Coverage (WUENIC) for PCV3 and Hib3. We quantified the spectrum transition under two denominators (26- and 29-pathogen calibers), constructed a share-by-intervenability matrix assigning each pathogen to a dominant intervention channel (vaccine-reachable, mixed, platform-sensitive) under explicit classification rules, compared platform-sensitive deaths with a transparently computed scenario of residual vaccine-preventable deaths, and cross-classified pathogens by age tropism and poverty lock. We anchored platform interventions to verified published evidence. Results The vaccine-preventable group share fell from 54.0% to 40.2% while the opportunistic/hospital group rose from 18.1% to 23.1% (29-pathogen caliber, 1990-2023). Super-region vaccine coverage showed no significant association with pathogen-share change (PCV3 Spearman rho = 0.108, p = 0.818; Hib3 rho = -0.036, p = 0.939), a null result we report as evidence that simple coverage-burden correlations do not hold at the regional level, not as evidence against vaccine value. In 2023, vaccine-reachable pathogens accounted for 441,410 deaths (45.7%, channel including COVID-19), mixed for 126,926 (13.1%), and platform-sensitive pathogens for 396,995 (41.1%). Platform-sensitive deaths were 2.9-5.1 times the scenario estimate of residual vaccine-preventable deaths (52,435-77,512). Nine of 14 classifiable pathogens fell into the poverty-locked, infant-tropic cell (480,922 deaths; Fisher OR = 9.0, p = 0.1758). Conclusions The marginal value of single-pathogen strategies declines as the spectrum diversifies and residual deaths concentrate in platform-sensitive, poverty-locked, infant-tropic pathogens. Vaccine scale-up remains a certain and sizeable opportunity; the next increment of marginal resources should increasingly fund platform capabilities (oxygen systems, antimicrobial access and stewardship, infection prevention and control, referral, and nutrition) delivered as a package to the populations where the residual burden is locked.
items.abstract_zh: 背景 儿童肺炎死亡率的历史性下降在很大程度上由针对b型流感嗜血杆菌（Hib）和肺炎链球菌的单病原体疫苗驱动。然而，儿童肺炎死亡背后的病原谱正在多样化：病原体有效数从1990年的5.57上升到2023年的9.94，且剩余负担正转向尚无获批儿童疫苗的机会性和医院相关病原体。本文追问在这一转变推进过程中，资源应如何在单病原体干预与平台投资之间排序。方法 我们分析了2023年全球疾病负担研究中0-19岁、按超级区域划分的29种病原体所致死亡，并结合WHO/UNICEF PCV3和Hib3国家免疫覆盖率估计（WUENIC）。我们在两种分母（26种和29种病原体口径）下量化了病原谱转变，构建按可干预性划分的份额矩阵，在明确分类规则下将每种病原体归入主要干预渠道（疫苗可及、混合、平台敏感），将平台敏感死亡与透明计算的剩余疫苗可预防死亡情景进行比较，并按年龄趋向性和贫困锁定对病原体进行交叉分类。我们将平台干预锚定于经核实的已发表证据。结果 疫苗可预防组份额从54.0%降至40.2%，而机会性/医院相关组从18.1%升至23.1%（29种病原体口径，1990-2023年）。超级区域疫苗覆盖率与病原体份额变化无显著关联（PCV3 Spearman rho=0.108，p=0.818；Hib3 rho=-0.036，p=0.939），我们将这一零结果报告为简单覆盖率-负担相关性在区域层面不成立的证据，而非反对疫苗价值的证据。2023年，疫苗可及病原体占441,410例死亡（45.7%，该渠道包括COVID-19），混合渠道占126,926例（13.1%），平台敏感病原体占396,995例（41.1%）。平台敏感死亡是剩余疫苗可预防死亡情景估计值（52,435-77,512）的2.9-5.1倍。14种可分类病原体中有9种落入贫困锁定、婴儿趋向性单元格（480,922例死亡；Fisher OR=9.0，p=0.1758）。结论 随着病原谱多样化且剩余死亡集中于平台敏感、贫困锁定、婴儿趋向性病原体，单病原体策略的边际价值下降。疫苗扩大仍是一个确定且规模可观的机遇；下一增量边际资源应越来越多地资助平台能力（氧气系统、抗菌药物可及性与管理、感染预防与控制、转诊和营养），并作为一揽子措施提供给剩余负担被锁定的人群。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生物建模与实验，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 区分计算预测、回顾性分析与实验验证；不把模型输出作为临床结论，数据和权重许可需单独核对。

items.title_en: Complex fluid flow dynamics by bright scattershot boson sampling
items.title_zh: 利用明亮散粒玻色采样研究复杂流体流动力学
items.abstract_en: Boson sampling machines have become a fruitful tool for establishing new concepts, which connect fundamental physics with computer science applications. Here, we exploit the intrinsically high-dimensional correlations generated by the measurement outcomes of a multiphoton boson sampling machine and demonstrate how a reconfigurable architecture can be programmed to autonomously model the time evolution of nonlinear dynamical systems that describe complex fluid flows. By extending on the original scattershot boson sampling (SBS) scheme to include higher photon number components -- a scheme which we label bright scattershot boson sampling (BSBS) --- this scheme overcomes scaling issues inherent to SBS-based schemes by utilizing all randomly generated input photon number distributions. We illustrate the capability of this scheme for two complex fluid-flow models: an eight-dimensional Lorenz-type model of two-dimensional thermally driven convection and a 16-dimensional model of global atmospheric circulation. Using a digital twin of the BSBS architecture based on multiphoton statistics, we show that the photonic approach accurately reproduces the temporal dynamics of both systems while being resilient to photon losses of up to 50 per cent. We also verified that the BSBS case outperforms a comparable run with coherent light. Moreover, its prediction horizon exceeds that of a classical reservoir-computing model with the same query complexity. These results highlight the potential of near-term photonic quantum computing for addressing relevant real-world tasks on noisy intermediate-scale devices.
items.abstract_zh: 玻色采样机器已成为建立新概念的有效工具，这些概念将基础物理与计算机科学应用联系起来。在这里，我们利用多光子玻色采样机器测量结果所生成的内在高维关联，并展示如何对可重构架构进行编程，以自主模拟描述复杂流体流动的非线性动力系统的时间演化。通过将原始散粒玻色采样（SBS）方案扩展到包含更高光子数成分——我们将该方案称为明亮散粒玻色采样（BSBS）——该方案利用所有随机生成的输入光子数分布，克服了基于SBS方案固有的扩展性问题。我们针对两个复杂流体流动模型说明该方案的能力：一个二维热驱动对流的八维Lorenz型模型和一个全球大气环流的16维模型。使用基于多光子统计的BSBS架构数字孪生，我们表明该光子方法能够准确再现两个系统的时间动力学，同时对高达50%的光子损耗具有鲁棒性。我们还验证了BSBS情形优于使用相干光的可比运行。此外，其预测时域超过了具有相同查询复杂度的经典储备池计算模型。这些结果凸显了近中期光子量子计算在噪声中等规模设备上处理相关现实世界任务的潜力。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为光学器件与计算，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对波长、器件、光路、噪声与实验条件；数值仿真不等于已制备器件或可直接部署。

items.title_en: How Robust are Pinching-Antenna Systems to Practical Deployment Imperfections?
items.title_zh: 夹持天线系统对实际部署不完美因素的鲁棒性如何？
items.abstract_en: This paper investigates the robustness of pinching-antenna systems (PASSs) to three practical deployment imperfections: pinching-antenna (PA) positioning errors, imperfect channel state information (CSI), and line-of-sight (LoS) blockages. We develop analytical frameworks to quantify the performance degradation caused by each imperfection. For PA positioning errors, we employ a Brownian meander model to characterize the distribution and mean of the resulting signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) loss. The results show that positioning errors can diminish the gains from long-term position selection, with the loss becoming more pronounced under stronger shadow fading. For imperfect CSI, we characterize the distribution and moments of the true scattered channel power at the position selected using noisy channel estimates. The resulting selection penalty is governed by the ratio of noise variance to the number of channel measurements, while the upper tail of the selected channel power retains the same behavior as under perfect CSI. Finally, we develop a spatially consistent blockage model and derive the distribution of the optimum long-term SNR for arbitrary blockage configurations, together with a numerically tractable expression for a single blockage. Simulation results validate the analyses and highlight a fundamental property of PASSs: although positioning errors and imperfect CSI can reduce the gains from position selection, good performance can still be achieved provided that an LoS link is available. In particular, even when a large proportion of the waveguide is blocked, PA repositioning can establish LoS links and enable performance close to that of a fully unblocked system for the considered configurations.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究夹持天线系统（PASSs）对三种实际部署不完美因素的鲁棒性：夹持天线（PA）定位误差、不完美信道状态信息（CSI）以及视距（LoS）阻塞。我们开发分析框架来量化每种不完美因素造成的性能退化。对于PA定位误差，我们采用布朗蜿蜒模型来刻画由此产生的信噪比（SNR）损耗的分布和均值。结果表明，定位误差会削弱长期位置选择带来的增益，且在更强阴影衰落下令损耗更加明显。对于不完美CSI，我们刻画在使用含噪信道估计所选位置上真实散射信道功率的分布和矩。由此产生的选择惩罚由噪声方差与信道测量次数之比决定，而所选信道功率的上尾仍保持与完美CSI下相同的行为。最后，我们开发空间一致的阻塞模型，并推导任意阻塞配置下最优长期SNR的分布，以及单个阻塞下数值可处理的表达式。仿真结果验证了分析，并突出了PASSs的一个基本性质：尽管定位误差和不完美CSI会降低位置选择带来的增益，但只要存在可用的LoS链路，仍可实现良好性能。特别地，即使在大部分波导被阻塞时，PA重新定位也能建立LoS链路，并在所考虑配置下使性能接近完全未阻塞系统。

items.title_en: In the Eye of the Beholder: Human Label Variation in Textual and Visual Entailment
items.title_zh: 观者眼中：文本与视觉蕴含中的人类标签变异
items.abstract_en: Human Label Variation (HLV) is increasingly recognised as an informative signal that reflects meaningful differences in how people interpret the same input. While HLV has been studied extensively in Natural Language Inference (NLI), much less is known about HLV in Visual Entailment (VE; Xie et al., 2019), where the textual premise is replaced by an image, keeping the hypothesis and label space fixed. We introduce VariNLI-VE, a dataset for studying how HLV changes between paired NLI and VE instances. We re-annotate a subset of originally neutral SNLI (Bowman et al., 2015) instances and their visual counterparts, with the same annotators evaluating both the textual and visual versions. Each annotation includes a label, confidence score, and explanation, yielding 2,250 annotations. Labels and explanations are collected jointly, providing ecologically valid explanations. Because the image may reveal information not stated in the text, one might expect disagreement to decrease in VE. Instead, we find no clear overall reduction: disagreement decreases for some instances while it increases for others. Explanations reveal further variation, as annotators can retain the same label while changing their rationale. When evaluating vision-language models (VLMs) on the paired data, we find lower accuracy, weaker alignment with human label distributions, and generally higher uncertainty in VE than in NLI.
items.abstract_zh: 人类标签变异（HLV）日益被视为一种信息性信号，反映了人们对同一输入解读的有意义差异。虽然HLV已在自然语言推理（NLI）中得到广泛研究，但关于视觉蕴含（VE；Xie et al., 2019）中的HLV所知甚少，其中文本前提被图像替换，假设和标签空间保持不变。我们引入VariNLI-VE，一个用于研究配对的NLI和VE实例之间HLV如何变化的数据集。我们重新标注了原本为中性SNLI（Bowman et al., 2015）实例的一个子集及其视觉对应实例，由同一批标注者评估文本版本和视觉版本。每个标注包括标签、置信度分数和解释，共产生2,250个标注。标签和解释联合收集，提供生态有效的解释。由于图像可能揭示文本未陈述的信息，人们可能预期VE中的分歧会减少。相反，我们发现总体没有明显减少：某些实例的分歧减少，而另一些实例的分歧增加。解释揭示了进一步变异，因为标注者可以保持相同标签而改变其理由。在配对数据上评估视觉-语言模型（VLM）时，我们发现与NLI相比，VE中的准确率更低、与人类标签分布的对齐更弱，且不确定性总体更高。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: In Situ Monitoring and Predictive Modeling of Harmful Algal Blooms with Autonomous Surface Vehicles
items.title_zh: 利用自主水面艇对有害藻华进行原位监测与预测建模
items.abstract_en: Harmful Algal Blooms (HABs) pose significant environmental, economic, and public-health challenges in coastal and inland water bodies, creating a need for scalable methods to collect spatially distributed water-quality data. This paper presents an autonomous surface vessel-based sensing system for in-situ water-quality monitoring related to harmful algal bloom detection. The system integrates a BlueBoat Autonomous Surface Vessel (ASV), a motorized winch for depth-controlled sonde deployment, a multiparameter water-quality sonde, side-scan sonar, and an event-camera payload. Autonomous waypoint missions were used to collect measurements across selected sampling regions and multiple depths, enabling both horizontal and vertical characterization of environmental conditions. Field deployments were conducted in Lake Pontchartrain, Louisiana, with additional measurements collected in False River, Louisiana to increase dataset diversity. The collected measurements included algal pigment indicators, nutrient concentration, turbidity, temperature, and other water-quality parameters relevant to bloom formation. In addition, complementary sonar and event-camera data were collected during vehicle operation to provide contextual environmental information. A machine-learning classification approach was also evaluated using the collected water-quality measurements to support HAB and non-HAB classification. The results demonstrate the feasibility of using a modular ASV platform for repeatable, multi-modal water-quality data collection and support future development of autonomous monitoring systems.
items.abstract_zh: 有害藻华（HABs）在沿海和内陆水体中构成重大的环境、经济和公共健康挑战，因此需要可扩展的方法来收集空间分布的水质数据。本文提出一种基于自主水面艇的传感系统，用于与有害藻华检测相关的原位水质监测。该系统集成了BlueBoat自主水面艇（ASV）、用于深度控制探针部署的电动绞车、多参数水质探针、侧扫声呐和事件相机载荷。自主航点任务被用于在选定的采样区域和多个深度收集测量，从而实现环境条件的水平和垂直表征。在路易斯安那州庞恰特雷恩湖进行了现场部署，并在路易斯安那州False River额外收集测量以增加数据集多样性。收集的测量包括藻类色素指标、营养物浓度、浊度、温度以及与藻华形成相关的其他水质参数。此外，在载具运行期间收集了补充的声呐和事件相机数据，以提供上下文环境信息。还评估了一种机器学习分类方法，使用收集的水质测量来支持HAB和非HAB分类。结果证明了使用模块化ASV平台进行可重复、多模态水质数据收集的可行性，并支持自主监测系统的未来发展。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Real-Time Diffusion Relighting as a Neural Sensor: Closing the Low-Light Domain Gap for Robotic Perception
items.title_zh: 作为神经传感器的实时扩散重光照：弥合机器人感知的低光照域差距
items.abstract_en: Low-light conditions severely degrade robotic perception: object detectors trained on daylight imagery are prone to failure under dark and adverse weather conditions that fall outside of their training distribution. Furthermore, from an efficiency standpoint, existing Low-Light Image Enhancement (LLIE) methods are designed for offline processing and are therefore impractical to integrate into live control loops. To address these issues, we propose to embed a Generative Neural Sensor within the control loop that treats illumination as a generative prior rather than a signal processing problem, enabling task-relevant semantic recovery. We further propose an Real-Time Perceptual Architecture that decouples high-latency semantic recovery from low-latency robotic control. Rather than blocking the control loop, our system runs a large-scale image-to-image diffusion model in a background thread, and is activated only when a drop in detection confidence signals a perceptual uncertainty event, significantly reducing computational overhead. Our method sets a new state-of-the-art performance on the ExDark low-light benchmark with 87.1% mAP, and under adverse weather conditions, significantly boosts detection rates over competing methods. On a navigation task in a closed-loop autonomous driving simulator (CARLA), we achieve a 100% lap completion rate, establishing a simulation-based proof-of-concept for integrating high-latency generative models with standard robotic control autonomy stacks.
items.abstract_zh: 低光照条件会严重降低机器人感知性能：在日光图像上训练的目标检测器，在黑暗和恶劣天气等超出其训练分布的条件下容易失效。此外，从效率角度看，现有的低光照图像增强（LLIE）方法是为离线处理设计的，因此难以集成到实时控制回路中。为解决这些问题，我们提出在控制回路中嵌入一个生成式神经传感器，将光照视为生成先验而非信号处理问题，从而实现任务相关的语义恢复。我们进一步提出一种实时感知架构，将高延迟的语义恢复与低延迟的机器人控制解耦。我们的系统不会阻塞控制回路，而是在后台线程中运行大规模图像到图像扩散模型，并且仅在检测置信度下降表明出现感知不确定性事件时激活，从而显著降低计算开销。我们的方法在 ExDark 低光照基准上取得 87.1% mAP 的新最先进性能，并在恶劣天气条件下显著提高检测率，优于竞争方法。在闭环自动驾驶模拟器（CARLA）的导航任务中，我们实现了 100% 的圈完成率，为将高延迟生成模型与标准机器人控制自主栈集成提供了基于仿真的概念验证。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Multi-Ancestry Rare and Low-Frequency Variant Analysis Reveals Novel and Convergent Biological Pathways for Cannabis Use Disorder
items.title_zh: 多祖先罕见和低频变异分析揭示大麻使用障碍的新颖且趋同的生物通路
items.abstract_en: Large disparities in Cannabis Use Disorder (CUD) prevalence exist across U.S ethnic groups, yet genetic research has disproportionately focused on individuals of European descent. This study investigated the genetic architecture of CUD severity across three populations--American Indians, Mexican Americans, and European Americans--focusing on rare and low-frequency variants (minor allele frequency < 5%). CUD severity was measured using a validated composite of 20 cannabis-related life events, enhancing phenotypic resolution and power. In American Indians, ten genome-wide significant common variants were identified. Analyses of rare and low-frequency functional variants revealed novel, convergent biological pathways across ancestries. Notably, the arylsulfatases activation pathway was significantly associated with CUD severity in Mexican Americans and supported in American Indians, implicating sulfated lipids such as sphingolipids in CUD neurobiology. Related, in European Americans, the heparan sulfate degradation pathway--central to synaptic remodeling and extracellular matrix regulation--showed significant negative association with CUD severity. The integrin beta-1 cell surface interaction pathway, critical for neuronal adhesion and signaling, was uniquely enriched in Mexican Americans. Immune-related pathways, including shared involvement of a p38-gamma/delta MAPK signaling cascade, were supported across multiple cohorts. These findings highlight both ancestry-specific and shared mechanisms contributing to CUD severity, emphasizing the biological complexity of addiction. Importantly, these pathways represent potential therapeutic targets, suggesting that modulation of sulfated lipid metabolism and extracellular matrix remodeling may offer novel strategies for intervention. By integrating multi-ethnic cohorts and rare variant analyses, this study identifies underappreciated genetic contributors to CUD and underscores the importance of population-informed addiction genetics research.
items.abstract_zh: 大麻使用障碍（CUD）患病率在美国不同族裔群体之间存在巨大差异，然而遗传研究不成比例地集中于欧洲血统个体。本研究考察了三个群体——美洲印第安人、墨西哥裔美国人和欧洲裔美国人——中CUD严重程度的遗传结构，重点关注罕见和低频变异（次要等位基因频率<5%）。CUD严重程度使用由20个与大麻相关的生活事件组成的经验证复合指标测量，从而提高了表型分辨率和统计功效。在美洲印第安人中，鉴定出十个全基因组显著常见变异。对罕见和低频功能变异的分析揭示了跨祖先的新颖且趋同的生物通路。值得注意的是，芳基硫酸酯酶激活通路在墨西哥裔美国人中与CUD严重程度显著相关，并在美洲印第安人中得到支持，提示硫酸化脂质（如鞘脂）参与CUD神经生物学。相关地，在欧洲裔美国人中，对突触重塑和细胞外基质调控至关重要的硫酸乙酰肝素降解通路与CUD严重程度呈显著负相关。对神经元黏附和信号传导至关重要的整合素β-1细胞表面相互作用通路在墨西哥裔美国人中独特富集。免疫相关通路，包括共同涉及的p38-γ/δ MAPK信号级联，在多个队列中得到支持。这些发现突出了促成CUD严重程度的祖先特异性和共享机制，强调了成瘾的生物学复杂性。重要的是，这些通路代表潜在治疗靶点，表明调节硫酸化脂质代谢和细胞外基质重塑可能提供新的干预策略。通过整合多种族队列和罕见变异分析，本研究识别出未被充分认识的CUD遗传贡献因素，并强调基于人群的成瘾遗传学研究的重要性。

items.title_en: Dissipation as a Resource for Entanglement via High-Spin Mediator Purification
items.title_zh: 通过高自旋中介纯化将耗散作为纠缠资源
items.abstract_en: We study entanglement generation between two spin qubits mediated by a single, thermally mixed, high-spin ($S=5/2$) magnetic impurity, using the Lindblad master equation to compare coherent and dissipative control of the mediator. We show that no coherent drive, however strong or resonant, can purify the mediator beyond its thermal value --- a direct consequence of unitary evolution exactly preserving state purity --- while a dissipative channel purifies it up to the limit set by the optical pumping cycle itself, $\mathrm{Tr}[ρ_M^2]\approx0.8$. Modeling this channel with rates fixed by the measured optical pumping of a single Mn spin, we find that the entanglement it enables is not monotonic in the pump strength: it peaks at a finite rate and then decreases, since the same channel leaks decoherence to the qubits through the coupling that mediates their entanglement. At the experimental pumping rate, a single $80$ns pulse purifies the mediator, the resulting polarization persists for a timescale three orders of magnitude longer than the entangling dynamics, and the first-recurrence negativity rises from $0.18$ to $0.64$ at $12$K, remaining above $0.6$ up to $30$K. These results establish dissipation, not as noise to be suppressed, but as the very resource that makes robust entanglement generation possible.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究由单个热混合的高自旋（$S=5/2$）磁性杂质介导的两个自旋量子比特之间的纠缠产生，使用 Lindblad 主方程比较对中介的相干控制与耗散控制。我们表明，任何相干驱动，无论多强或共振，都不能将中介纯化到超过其热值——这是幺正演化精确保持态纯度的直接结果——而耗散通道可将其纯化到光泵浦循环本身所设定的极限，$\mathrm{Tr}[ρ_M^2]\approx0.8$。以由单个 Mn 自旋的实测光泵浦固定的速率对该通道建模，我们发现它所产生的纠缠对泵浦强度并非单调：它在一个有限速率处达到峰值然后下降，因为同一通道通过介导纠缠的耦合向量子比特泄漏退相干。在实验泵浦速率下，单个 $80$ns 脉冲纯化中介，所得极化持续的时间尺度比纠缠动力学长三个数量级，并且在 $12$K 时首次复现负度从 $0.18$ 升至 $0.64$，直至 $30$K 仍保持在 $0.6$ 以上。这些结果确立耗散不是应被抑制的噪声，而是使稳健纠缠产生成为可能的资源本身。

items.title_en: On the Limits of Sufficient Explanations
items.title_zh: 论充分解释的局限
items.abstract_en: We formally characterize the conditions under which sufficient explanations exist for classifiers on structured data such as graphs and strings. We focus on post-hoc explainers that select parts of the input as sufficient explanations. An explanation is sufficient if the selected part alone ensures the predicted label. Sufficient explanations have been widely adopted across data modalities, including graphs, strings, and images. However, a unified formal analysis of sufficient explanations remains missing. We bridge this gap with four main contributions: (i) We define a general explanation formalism consisting of an instance space, a classifier, and a select relation. The select relation specifies which potential sub-instances or feature subsets can be selected as explanations from each instance; (ii) We show that the existence of sufficient explainers is fully characterized by the interplay between the classifier and the select relation; (iii) We extend this analysis to practically relevant variants of sufficiency, including probabilistic sufficiency and deletion sufficiency; (iv) Based on the formal analysis, we devise statistics that bound the maximum achievable sufficiency for a given task. We evaluate these statistics on language, protein, and molecular classification datasets and find that full sufficiency is unattainable on most of them. Since these bounds hold for every explainer, they provide a task-level reference against which any explainer's sufficiency can be judged in absolute terms.
items.abstract_zh: 我们对图、字符串等结构化数据上的分类器在何种条件下存在充分解释进行形式化刻画。我们关注事后解释器，它们选择输入的一部分作为充分解释。如果一个解释仅由所选部分就能确保预测标签，则该解释是充分的。充分解释已被广泛用于包括图、字符串和图像在内的多种数据模态。然而，仍缺少对充分解释的统一形式化分析。我们以四项主要贡献填补这一空白：（i）我们定义一种通用解释形式化，由实例空间、分类器和选择关系组成。选择关系指定从每个实例中可以选取哪些潜在子实例或特征子集作为解释；（ii）我们表明，充分解释器的存在性完全由分类器与选择关系之间的相互作用所刻画；（iii）我们将该分析扩展到实际相关的充分性变体，包括概率充分性和删除充分性；（iv）基于该形式化分析，我们设计统计量来界定给定任务可达到的最大充分性。我们在语言、蛋白质和分子分类数据集上评估这些统计量，发现其中大多数数据集无法达到完全充分性。由于这些界对每个解释器都成立，它们提供了一个任务级参考，可据此以绝对方式判断任何解释器的充分性。

items.title_en: Can You Trust Your Finance Agent? Drift, Diagnosis and Auditable Intervention on One Shipped Financial Research Agent
items.title_zh: 你能信任你的金融智能体吗？对单个已交付金融研究智能体的漂移、诊断与可审计干预
items.abstract_en: Can you trust a finance agent you did not build? We take the reference agent shipped with the Vals Finance Agent Benchmark v2, leave it untuned, and ask four questions a leaderboard score does not answer. Is the score stable? Seven identical runs on 18 questions pass between 105 and 123 of 149 rubric criteria, and the bill varies by up to 17%. When the agent fails, who owns the fix? We classify 20 failed trajectories, from three runs of nine held-out questions, by the layer whose owner would remedy them, under a taxonomy frozen in advance: 13 belong to the agent's instructions, 3 to its tools, 4 to the model, none to its data. Can that diagnosis be trusted? Four blind readers from three model families, given only the traces, name the same fault as our LLM analyzer in 94% of cases, the rate at which they agree with one another (93%). Can a change be trusted? An optimization loop reads the traces, makes one targeted change per round and keeps it only if it clears a fixed threshold. Under a cost objective its final configuration costs 0.34x the baseline on the held-out questions (95% CI [0.22, 0.58]) at accuracy within noise. Under an accuracy objective it gains 14 points on the development questions and 1.5 on the held-out ones (CI [-5.3, +7.2]). Judged against the measured run-to-run noise, under a rule written before the test was opened, the first is a real saving and the second is not. This is a case study of one agent and nine test questions, not a general result.
items.abstract_zh: 你能信任一个不是你构建的金融智能体吗？我们取用 Vals Finance Agent Benchmark v2 随附的参考智能体，保持其未调优，并提出排行榜分数无法回答的四个问题。分数稳定吗？在 18 个问题上进行七次相同运行，通过 149 条评分标准中的 105 至 123 条，费用最多变化 17%。当智能体失败时，谁负责修复？在预先冻结的分类体系下，按应由哪一层的负责人修复来对 20 条失败轨迹进行分类，这些轨迹来自对九个留出问题的三次运行：13 条属于智能体的指令，3 条属于其工具，4 条属于模型，没有属于其数据的。该诊断可以被信任吗？来自三个模型家族的四个盲读者仅获得轨迹，在 94% 的情况下指出与我们 LLM 分析器相同的故障，这一比例与他们彼此之间的一致率（93%）相当。更改可以被信任吗？一个优化循环读取轨迹，每轮做一次有针对性的更改，并且仅当其超过固定阈值时才保留该更改。在成本目标下，其最终配置在留出问题上的成本为基线的 0.34 倍（95% CI [0.22, 0.58]），准确率在噪声范围内。在准确率目标下，它在开发问题上提升 14 个百分点，在留出问题上提升 1.5 个百分点（CI [-5.3, +7.2]）。按照在测试打开之前写定的规则，以测得的运行间噪声为参照来判断，前者是真实节省，后者不是。这是对一个智能体和九个测试问题的案例研究，不是一般性结果。

items.title_en: NPU-Accelerated GNSS Signal Acquisition
items.title_zh: NPU 加速的 GNSS 信号捕获
items.abstract_en: On small single-board computers (SBCs), GNSS signal acquisition is a major CPU load. This paper proposes using the neural processing unit (NPU) of an SBC not for machine learning but as an accelerator for the parallel code search in GNSS signal acquisition. The discrete Fourier transform (DFT) used in acquisition is decomposed by the four-step DFT into matrix products of small DFTs and expressed by $1\times1$ convolutions, element-wise products, and transposes, which NPUs execute efficiently. Furthermore, we propose a method that divides the DFT, the non-coherent integration, and the peak detection between the CPU and the NPU according to the configuration of the NPU (an NPU with its own memory connected via PCIe, or an NPU sharing memory with the CPU). The proposed method is implemented in the open-source software GNSS receiver Pocket SDR and evaluated on a Raspberry Pi 5 combined with the external AX8850 NPU and on the NPU built into the SoC (RK3588) of the ROCK 5C, a small SBC of comparable size. Compared with acquisition by an optimized CPU implementation, the acquisition of short codes on the Raspberry Pi 5 with the AX8850 is 3.0-3.8 times faster. In the evaluation of the whole receiver, the number of tracking channels that reach their first lock within 30 s with the NPU is 1.5 times that with the CPU, and the time until 90% of the channels are locked is reduced from 66 s to 26 s. Furthermore, because the CPU load of acquisition is reduced, the number of tracking channels that can be processed in real time increases from about 175 to about 230. These results show that using the NPU on SBCs with limited CPU resources is effective for achieving both GNSS signal acquisition and tracking. The implementation is publicly available as open source under the name PocketSDR-NPU.
items.abstract_zh: 在小型单板计算机（SBC）上，GNSS 信号捕获是主要的 CPU 负载。本文提出使用 SBC 的神经处理单元（NPU）并非用于机器学习，而是作为 GNSS 信号捕获中并行码搜索的加速器。捕获中使用的离散傅里叶变换（DFT）通过四步 DFT 分解为小 DFT 的矩阵乘积，并用 $1\times1$ 卷积、逐元素乘积和转置表示，NPU 可高效执行这些操作。此外，我们提出一种方法，根据 NPU 的配置（通过 PCIe 连接且具有自身存储器的 NPU，或与 CPU 共享存储器的 NPU）在 CPU 和 NPU 之间划分 DFT、非相干积分和峰值检测。所提方法在开源软件 GNSS 接收机 Pocket SDR 中实现，并在与外部 AX8850 NPU 组合的 Raspberry Pi 5 上，以及在 ROCK 5C（尺寸相当的小型 SBC）的 SoC（RK3588）内置 NPU 上评估。与优化 CPU 实现的捕获相比，在配备 AX8850 的 Raspberry Pi 5 上对短码的捕获快 3.0-3.8 倍。在整个接收机的评估中，使用 NPU 时在 30 s 内达到首次锁定的跟踪通道数是使用 CPU 时的 1.5 倍，并且 90% 的通道被锁定所需时间从 66 s 降至 26 s。此外，由于捕获的 CPU 负载降低，可实时处理的跟踪通道数从约 175 增加到约 230。这些结果表明，在 CPU 资源有限的 SBC 上使用 NPU 对于同时实现 GNSS 信号捕获和跟踪是有效的。该实现以 PocketSDR-NPU 为名作为开源公开可用。

items.title_en: Transmission-Mode Multispectral Imaging for Estimation of Microcystis spp. Cell Concentration and ELISA-Equivalent Microcystin Concentration in Water
items.title_zh: 透射模式多光谱成像用于估算水中微囊藻属细胞浓度和ELISA当量微囊藻毒素浓度
items.abstract_en: Harmful algal blooms dominated by Microcystis spp. threaten freshwater systems through proliferation and microcystin (MC) production. Conventional measurements of cyanobacterial abundance and MC concentration commonly require laboratory processing, specialized instrumentation, or assay reagents. Because MC concentration cannot always be reliably inferred from cell abundance, complementary optical approaches for estimating both quantities are of interest. This study proposes and evaluates a transmission mode multispectral imaging (MSI) framework for estimating Microcystis spp. cell concentration and ELISA-equivalent MC concentration from culture derived dilution samples. A custom built MSI system acquiring twelve spectral bands from near-ultraviolet to near-infrared wavelengths measured transmitted light spectral responses. Following principal component analysis based dimensionality reduction, spectral variation was quantified using an aggregated Wasserstein distance descriptor for regression based prediction. Cell concentration estimation yielded $R^2=0.9819$ for calibration and $R^2=0.9754$ on held-out intermediate dilution levels, while ELISA-equivalent MC estimation yielded $R^2=0.9788$ for calibration and $R^2=0.9786$ on held-out intermediate dilution levels. These results demonstrate the feasibility of transmission-mode MSI as a dual output optical calibration framework for estimation of Microcystis spp. cell concentration and ELISA-equivalent MC concentration in water.
items.abstract_zh: 以微囊藻属（Microcystis spp.）为优势种的有害藻华通过增殖和微囊藻毒素（MC）生成威胁淡水系统。蓝细菌丰度和MC浓度的常规测量通常需要实验室处理、专用仪器或检测试剂。由于MC浓度并非总能由细胞丰度可靠推断，因此估算这两个量的互补光学方法受到关注。本研究提出并评估一种透射模式多光谱成像（MSI）框架，用于从来源于培养物的稀释样品中估算微囊藻属细胞浓度和ELISA当量MC浓度。一套定制的MSI系统采集从近紫外到近红外波长的12个光谱波段，测量透射光光谱响应。在基于主成分分析的降维之后，使用聚合Wasserstein距离描述符量化光谱变化，以进行基于回归的预测。细胞浓度估算在校准中给出$R^2=0.9819$，在留出的中间稀释水平上给出$R^2=0.9754$；ELISA当量MC估算在校准中给出$R^2=0.9788$，在留出的中间稀释水平上给出$R^2=0.9786$。这些结果证明透射模式MSI作为一种双输出光学校准框架，用于估算水中微囊藻属细胞浓度和ELISA当量MC浓度的可行性。
authors: K. A. D. S. A. Perera

items.title_en: Is sediment porosity a confounder in sedimentary DNA records? A test in a temperate semi-enclosed bay
items.title_zh: 沉积物孔隙度是沉积 DNA 记录中的混杂因素吗？一项在温带半封闭海湾中的检验
items.abstract_en: Sedimentary environmental DNA (eDNA) has recently been widely used to reconstruct biological communities and to clarify ecosystem dynamics in natural environments. Sediment porosity is thought to influence DNA preservation, but whether it explains variation in sedimentary eDNA beyond depositional setting and burial depth has rarely been tested in natural environments. We analysed metabarcoding data of 18S rRNA and cytochrome c oxidase subunit I (COI) together with porosity profiles from eight cores (to 6 m depth) collected from the inner and mouth regions of Uranouchi Bay, Japan. Surface sediments generally showed higher taxonomic richness and read abundance, whereas deeper layers exhibited taxon-dependent decreases in detection frequency. PERMANOVA revealed significant effects of both region and depth on community composition for 18S and COI datasets (p = 0.001). After accounting for site and burial depth, depth-adjusted porosity explained only a small and non-significant fraction of the variation in community composition (18S: 1.0%, p = 0.74; COI: 4.0%, p = 0.052). In contrast, exploratory class-level analyses showed that diatom classes were negatively associated with depth-adjusted porosity in both markers. Our results indicate that sedimentary eDNA records are primarily structured by depositional setting and burial depth, with porosity contributing little additional explanatory power at the community level within the range observed here. The consistent response of diatoms, however, suggests that porosity effects may be taxon-specific, warranting targeted evaluation in future sedimentary eDNA studies.
items.abstract_zh: 沉积环境 DNA（eDNA）近来已被广泛用于重建生物群落并阐明自然环境中的生态系统动态。沉积物孔隙度被认为会影响 DNA 保存，但其是否能在沉积环境和埋藏深度之外解释沉积 eDNA 的变化，鲜有在自然环境中得到检验。我们分析了 18S rRNA 和细胞色素 c 氧化酶亚基 I（COI）的宏条形码数据，以及来自日本 Uranouchi 湾内部和湾口区域八个岩芯（至 6 m 深度）的孔隙度剖面。表层沉积物通常表现出更高的分类丰富度和读段丰度，而更深层则表现出依赖于分类单元的检测频率下降。PERMANOVA 显示，区域和深度对 18S 和 COI 数据集的群落组成均有显著影响（p = 0.001）。在考虑站点和埋藏深度后，经深度调整的孔隙度仅解释了群落组成变化的一小部分且不显著（18S：1.0%，p = 0.74；COI：4.0%，p = 0.052）。相比之下，探索性纲级分析显示，硅藻纲在两个标记中均与经深度调整的孔隙度呈负相关。我们的结果表明，沉积 eDNA 记录主要由沉积环境和埋藏深度决定，在此处观察到的范围内，孔隙度在群落层面提供的额外解释力很小。然而，硅藻的一致响应表明，孔隙度效应可能具有分类单元特异性，值得在未来沉积 eDNA 研究中进行有针对性的评估。

items.title_en: Topological phase diagram of an extended Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model with negative coupling
items.title_zh: 具有负耦合的扩展Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型的拓扑相图
items.abstract_en: Recently, an extended Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model with three atoms per unit cell has been experimentally realized in perovskite exciton-polariton micropillars. A distinctive feature of this system is that the second and third bands undergo a topological transition through a band crossing at the wave vector $k=0$, associated with a negative coupling. In this work, we analytically determine the phase diagram of the model as a function of the on-site energy splitting and the ratio of intercell to intracell hopping amplitudes. We identify seven regions in this lane, with four distinct topological phases, characterized by different Zak phases of the three bands. Our results provide a useful theoretical framework for interpreting existing experiments and serve as a guide for future experimental investigations of this system.
items.abstract_zh: 最近，每晶胞含三个原子的扩展Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型已在钙钛矿激子-极化激元微柱中实验实现。该系统的一个显著特征是，第二和第三能带通过波矢$k=0$处的能带交叉发生拓扑转变，并与负耦合相关联。在本工作中，我们以局域能分裂以及晶胞间与晶胞内跃迁振幅之比为函数，解析确定了该模型的相图。我们在该相图中识别出七个区域，包含四个不同的拓扑相，并由三个能带的不同Zak相位表征。我们的结果为解释现有实验提供了有用的理论框架，并为该系统的未来实验研究提供了指导。
